# Feature Inventory (/docs/research/feature-inventory)



# Feature Inventory [#feature-inventory]

**Snapshot:** Kwiva framework repo at `552115f` (main; packages at 0.2.0 RC-era). All features below are verified against source. `Studio`, `addons`, `cloud` are explicitly **not** in the inventory (they are roadmap on the framework side).

***

## 1. Factories (`defineX` — one grammar across packages) [#1-factories-definex--one-grammar-across-packages]

| Factory            | Package                   | Location (`packages/<pkg>/src/...`) | Notes                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `defineApp`        | `@kwiva/core`             | `app/define-app.ts`                 | returns `{name, models?, controllers?, middleware?, services?, policies?, pages?, jobs?, events?, commands?, macros?, state?, decorate?, resolve?}` additive |
| `defineConfig`     | `@kwiva/core`             | `config/define-config.ts`           | section validator                                                                                                                                            |
| `defineService`    | `@kwiva/core`             | `app/define-service.ts`             | `(factory: (ctx: {context: AppContext}) => T) => ServiceFactory<T>`                                                                                          |
| `defineModel`      | `@kwiva/data`             | `model/define-model.ts`             | `(factory: (f: FieldsApi) => F, options?) => Model<...>`                                                                                                     |
| `defineController` | `@kwiva/http`             | `controller/define-controller.ts`   | `{prefix?, middleware?, middlewareGroups?, routes(api)}`                                                                                                     |
| `defineContract`   | `@kwiva/http`             | `controller/define-contract.ts`     | typed request/response contracts                                                                                                                             |
| `defineMiddleware` | `@kwiva/http`             | `middleware/define-middleware.ts`   | `defineMiddleware(step) => Middleware{step, preflight?}`                                                                                                     |
| `definePage`       | `@kwiva/ui`               | `pages/define-page.ts`              | SSR pages (free-form or `(path, options)`)                                                                                                                   |
| `defineIsland`     | `@kwiva/ui`               | `islands/define-island.ts`          | client islands                                                                                                                                               |
| `defineJob`        | `@kwiva/jobs`             | `job/define-job.ts`                 | validated, frozen, const-suffix identity                                                                                                                     |
| `defineTask`       | `@kwiva/jobs`             | `job/define-task.ts`                | `{schedule?, description?, preventOverlapping, onSuccess?, onFailure?, handler}`                                                                             |
| `defineEvent`      | `@kwiva/events`           | `event/define-event.ts`             | `{broadcast?, broadcastOn?, broadcastAs?, broadcastWith?, broadcastWhen?, listeners?, queued?, schema?}`                                                     |
| `defineListener`   | `@kwiva/events`           | `listener/*`                        | `{on, handle, failed?, shouldHandle?, queue?}`                                                                                                               |
| `defineSubscriber` | `@kwiva/events`           | `subscriber/define-subscriber.ts`   | `{name?, events}`                                                                                                                                            |
| `defineMail`       | `@kwiva/mail`             | `mail/define-mail.ts`               | `{to, from?, cc?, bcc?, replyTo?, subject, render(data), html?, markdown?, text?, tags?, metadata?, attachments?}`                                           |
| `defineMcpTool`    | `@kwiva/mcp`              | `tool/define-mcp-tool.ts`           | `{description?, input, ability, handler}`                                                                                                                    |
| `definePolicy`     | `@kwiva/auth`             | `policy/define-policy.ts`           | deny-by-default, frozen                                                                                                                                      |
| `defineGate`       | `@kwiva/auth`             | `gate/*`                            | `{kind:"gate"}` frozen                                                                                                                                       |
| `defineBetterAuth` | `@kwiva/auth-better-auth` | `define-better-auth.ts`             | sealed adapter (server-facing)                                                                                                                               |
| `defineCommand`    | `@kwiva/cli`              | `command/define-command.ts`         | `{name, description?, options?, handler(options)}`                                                                                                           |

**Companion DSLs:** `defineMigration`, `defineSeeder`, `defineFactory` (@kwiva/data); `defineMcpTool` (@kwiva/mcp); `RedisStore`/`defineRedisStore`/`installRedisStore` (@kwiva/store-redis); `SmtpTransport`/`defineSmtpTransport` (@kwiva/mail-smtp); `ResendTransport`/`defineResendTransport` (@kwiva/mail-resend); `PgBossQueue`/`definePgBossQueue` (@kwiva/jobs-pg-boss).

**Storage (data):** `defineStorageDriver` — files-sdk adapter seam (sealed in `storage/files-adapter.ts`), drivers: local/memory/s3/gcs/azure/vercel-blob.

***

## 2. CLI commands (`kwiva` binary — `packages/cli`) [#2-cli-commands-kwiva-binary--packagescli]

### Framework commands [#framework-commands]

| Command                    | Args/Flags                  | Behavior                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `create <name>`            | `kwiva create <name>`       | Validated name `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`; refuses if exists. Scaffolds `bootstrap/`, `src/config/` (app, database, cache, kv, storage, mcp), `src/app/models/`, `src/app/http/controllers/`, `src/database/migrations/`, `src/database/seeders/`, `package.json` scripts (dev/build/test). |
| `dev`                      | `kwiva dev [--port <n>]`    | Dev server (supervises child, rebuilds, `src/.kwiva/serve.gen.ts`, SSE reload). `--port` default 3000; exits 0 on SIGINT/SIGTERM.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `build`                    | `kwiva build [--out <dir>]` | Client bundle → `src/.kwiva/entry.client.tsx` → `<out>/client`. Default out `dist`. Prints `kwiva build → <outFile> (<routes> routes, <pages> pages)`.                                                                                                                               |
| `test`                     | `kwiva test [-- <args>]`    | `bun test` in app root; exit code passthrough.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `migrate`                  | —                           | Apply all migrations from `src/database/migrations`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `migrate:status`           | —                           | Prints `applied: …` / `pending: …`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `migrate:down`             | —                           | Roll back last batch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `migrate:generate`         | —                           | Generate diffs from model IR (`migrateGenerate(models)`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `seed`                     | `kwiva seed [name]`         | Run all seeders (or one by name).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `task <name>`              | —                           | Run one task by name (`runTask`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `route:list`               | —                           | Print `METHOD  fullPath  routeId` lines.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `key:generate`             | —                           | Append `APP_KEY=<base64 32B>` to `.env` (mode 0600, refuses to overwrite).                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `storage:sync <from> <to>` | `[--prune] [--dry-run]`     | Copy objects between disks; skips unchanged; `--prune` deletes target-only.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `storage:clear [disk]`     | `[--force]`                 | Clear a disk (s3/gcs/azure need `--force`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `search:reindex [model]`   | —                           | Requires `database` section; `reindexSearch` per model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `mcp`                      | —                           | Serve MCP on stdio (auth forced `none`) with generated model + custom tools.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `mcp:print-config`         | —                           | Print agent config JSON (`mcpServers.kwiva{url, headers}`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `doctor`                   | —                           | Validate storage/search/mcp; `ok`/`fail` output; exit 1 on failure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `config-sections`          | —                           | Boot-seam helper (`applyConfigSections`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

### App commands (`defineCommand`, `src/app/commands/`) [#app-commands-definecommand-srcappcommands]

Discovered flat from `src/app/commands/`; required export shape: `{name: string, handler: fn}`. Parsed flags: `--name=value` / `--name value`; `optionKind`: boolean-default → `flag`, else `option`; defaults applied; `required` honored; `-h`/`--help` → generated help; errors → stderr + exit 1; unknown option/extra args → error.

| `model`      | `src/app/models`                  | `.ts`                    | —                   | —            |

## 3. Config sections (`src/config/*.ts`, discovered + validated) [#3-config-sections-srcconfigts-discovered--validated]

| Section    | Where   | Option shape                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app`      | core    | `{name?, port?: int (validated), host?}` — loader default `{port:3000, host:"localhost"}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `logger`   | core    | `{level?: "debug"\|"info"\|"warn"\|"error", sink?}` — default `{level:"info", sink:"console"}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `cache`    | core    | `{driver?: StoreDriverName, prefix?: string (default "kwiva"), defaultTtl?: number ms (default 60000; 0 = never), tags?: boolean (true), file?: {dir ("./var/cache")}, url?, swrGraceMs?: number (60000), waitUntil?: fn}`                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `kv`       | core    | `{driver?: StoreDriverName, namespace?: string (default "app"), defaultTtl?: number (300000), file?: {dir ("./var/kv")}, url?}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `database` | data    | `DatabaseConfig{driver: "pglite"\|"postgres" (required), dataDir?, url?, host?, port?, database?, username?, password?, pool?: PoolConfig{max?, idleTimeout?, connectionTimeout?, maxLifetime?}}`                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tenancy`  | data    | `TenancyConfig{defaults: {mode: "domain"\|"path"\|"header"\|"fixed"\|"org"\|"none" (default "path"), tenantField: string (default "tenant_id"), models: "*"\|string[] (default "*"), cache: {scoped: boolean (default true)}, storage: {scoped: boolean (default true)}}}`                                                                                                                            |
| `auth`     | auth    | `AuthConfig{providers: AuthProviderConfig[], session: AuthSessionConfig{secret (non-empty), maxAge (positive, seconds; default 604800), cookie?: {name?, httpOnly?, secure?, sameSite?: "lax"\|"strict"\|"none", path?, domain?}}, register?: {createUser(input), minPasswordLength?: int ≥ 1}, remember?: {maxAge?, cookie?}, rateLimit?: {login?: {max, windowMs}}, trustProxy?: boolean\|int ≥ 0}` |
| `client`   | client  | `ClientConfig{baseUrl (required, non-empty), headers?, credentials?: "omit"\|"same-origin"\|"include", fetch?, onError?, websocket?: {url, reconnect?: {enabled?, delay?, maxAttempts?}, headers?}}`                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `jobs`     | jobs    | `JobsConfig{driver: "memory", defaultQueue?, concurrency?, scheduler?: {enabled?, tickMs?, timezone?}, connections?: Record<string, {priority?}>}` — default `{driver:"memory"}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `events`   | events  | `EventsConfig{driver?: "sync"\|"queued", prefix?}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `mail`     | mail    | `MailConfig{transport?: "memory"\|"console"\|"smtp"\|"sendgrid"\|"resend", from?}` (applied via `setMailConfig` in boot seam)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `storage`  | storage | `StorageConfig{default?: string, disks?: Record<string, DiskConfig{driver: "local"\|"memory"\|"s3"\|"gcs"\|"azure"\|"vercel-blob", root?, publicUrl?, options?}>, tenant?: StorageTenantConfig{scoped?, prefix?}}`                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `mcp`      | mcp     | `McpConfig{enabled?, route? (starts with "/", default "/mcp"), transport?: "streamable"\|"stdio" (default "streamable"), auth?: "session"\|"bearer"\|"none" (default "session"; `none` only with stdio), models?: string[], controllers?: string[], readOnly?: boolean (false), scopes?: string[], requireTenant?: boolean (false)}`                                                                  |
| `search`   | search  | `SearchConfig{engine: "postgres", language? (must match Postgres regconfig pattern)}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

(`cache`/`kv` sections have **no file** — applied via `initCache`/`initKv`; `database` section is handled by `configureDatabase`; all section files discovered by filename in `src/config/`.)

***

## 4. Discovery glob conventions (`packages/core/src/app/discover.ts`) [#4-discovery-glob-conventions-packagescoresrcappdiscoverts]

`discoverKind(root, kind)` scans `DEFAULT_FOLDERS[kind]`:

| Kind          | Folder                     | Mode          | Notes                                                                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `models`      | `src/app/models`           | flat          | extensions `.ts/.tsx`, no `.d.ts`, no `.test.ts`                      |
| `services`    | `src/app/services`         | flat          | same                                                                  |
| `policies`    | `src/app/policies`         | flat          | `definePolicy`/`defineGate` detected by export shape                  |
| `jobs`        | `src/app/jobs`             | flat          | —                                                                     |
| `events`      | `src/app/events`           | flat          | `defineEvent` + `defineListener` in same folder                       |
| `tasks`       | `src/app/tasks`            | flat          | `runTask` callers discoverable via `defineTask`                       |
| `commands`    | `src/app/commands`         | flat          | required `{name, handler}` exports                                    |
| `controllers` | `src/app/http/controllers` | flat          | —                                                                     |
| `middleware`  | `src/app/http/middleware`  | flat          | —                                                                     |
| `pages`       | `src/ui/pages`             | **recursive** | route derived from relative path: `index` dropped, `$x`→`:x`, `$`→`*` |

Registration: object exports keyed by const name (`exported const`). `assembleApp(app, root)` = `discoverUnits` + additive merge (dedupe by name; throws on conflicts) + `derivePageRoute` for pages.

**Related globs outside `DEFAULT_FOLDERS`:**

* `discoverKind(root, "commands")` — CLI app commands (`src/app/commands/`).
* Migrations: `src/database/migrations` — recursive-ish flat (`readdirSync`, `*.ts/*.tsx/*.js`, no `.d.ts`), applied in name order.
* Seeders: `src/database/seeders` — same flat shape.
* MCP tools: `src/app/mcp/tools` — `Bun.Glob("**/*.{ts,tsx}")` recursive, skips `*.test.ts`.
* Client bundles: `src/ui/pages` + `src/ui/layouts` — recursive, route-derived; codegen → `src/.kwiva/types/route-tree.gen.ts`, `src/.kwiva/entry.client.tsx`.
* Mail: `src/app/mail` is **not** in `DEFAULT_FOLDERS` — config-driven (`setMailConfig` in boot seam).

***

## 2. `@kwiva/core` (v0.2.0) — `./helpers`, `./collection`, `./guards`, `./html` [#2-kwivacore-v020--helpers-collection-guards-html]

| `discoverUnits(root)` / `discoverKind(root, kind)`                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | functions | `Promise<UnitRegistry>` / `Promise<RegisteredUnit[]>`                                                                                                                                                    |
| `derivePageRoute(rel)`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | function  | `(rel: string) => string` — `index.tsx`→dir root, `$param`→`:param`, `$`→`*`                                                                                                                             |

### Helpers domain (`./helpers`) — Laravel-shaped (ADR-0023) [#helpers-domain-helpers--laravel-shaped-adr-0023]

| Symbol                                                                                                              | Kind      | Signature                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------- |

| Symbol                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Kind     | Signature                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `resetClient()`                                                                                                                                                                                         | function | —                                                                                       |
| `callRoute(routeId, args?, opts?)`                                                                                                                                                                      | function | → `Promise<unknown>`; throws normalized `ClientErrorShape`                              |

| `toClientError(status, value)`                                                                                                                                                                          | function | normalize Eden failure → `ClientErrorShape{code, message, status, requestId?, fields?}` |
| `substitutePath(template, params, routeId)`                                                                                                                                                             | function | → path string + params (`ClientErrorShape` on missing)                                  |
| Types: `ClientConfig{baseUrl, headers?, credentials?, fetch?, onError?, websocket?}`, `WebSocketConfig{url, reconnect?, headers?}`, `ReconnectPolicy{enabled, delay, maxAttempts}`, `InitClientOptions` | types    | —                                                                                       |

## 8. `@kwiva/jobs` (v0.2.0) [#8-kwivajobs-v020]

### Define + Validate [#define--validate]

| Symbol                                             | Kind     | Signature                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineJob<T>(options: DefineJobOptions<T>)`       | function | → frozen `Job<T>`; validated (tries ≥ 1, backoff ≥ 0, timeoutMs > 0, jitter default true)           |
| `validateJobInput<T>(job, raw)`                    | function | → validated input; throws `ValidationError`                                                         |
| `executeJobOnce(job, rawInput, ref)`               | function | one attempt: decrypt → validate → middleware → timeout race                                         |
| `computeBackoffDelay(job, failedAttempt, random?)` | function | fixed/exponential, capped, jittered                                                                 |
| `defineTask(options)`                              | function | → `Task{kind:"task", schedule?, description?, preventOverlapping, onSuccess?, onFailure?, handler}` |
| `runTask(task, opts?)`                             | function | fires `onSuccess`/`onFailure`                                                                       |

### Dispatch [#dispatch]

| Symbol                                     | Kind      | Signature                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dispatch(job, input, opts?)`              | function  | → `Promise<string>` record id                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `dispatchAfterResponse(job, input, opts?)` | function  | void (scope-aware)                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `dispatchSync(job, input, opts?)`          | function  | → result (1 attempt, no retries)                                                                                                                                                               |
| `dispatchChain(entries, opts?)`            | function  | sequential; `ChainResult{ok, results, failedIndex?, error?}`                                                                                                                                   |
| `dispatchBatch(options)`                   | function  | `BatchOptions{jobs: BatchEntry[], queue?, concurrency?, allowFailures?, then?, catch?, finally?}` → `BatchResult{ok, results, errors, skipped, handle: BatchHandle{id, cancel(), progress()}}` |
| `setDispatcher(fn)` / `resetDispatcher()`  | functions | fakeQueue seam                                                                                                                                                                                 |

### Queue engines [#queue-engines]

| Symbol                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Kind      | Signature                                                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `createMemoryQueue(options?)`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | function  | → `MemoryQueue{enqueue, due(now, queue?), ack, fail, has, size(queue?), pending(), failures(), clear()}` |
| `uniqueOwner/claimUnique/releaseUnique/settleUnique/clearUnique`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | functions | dedupe ledger                                                                                            |
| `createJobCipher(key)` → `{encrypt, decrypt}`; `setJobCipher/getJobCipher`; `encryptJobInput/decryptJobInput/isEncryptedJobInput`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | functions | AES-256-GCM                                                                                              |
| `enqueueOutbox(job, input, opts?)` / `drainOutbox(opts?)` / `getOutboxStore/setOutboxStore/resetOutboxStore`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | functions | transactional outbox; `OutboxRecord{id, job, input, queue, runAt, priority, enqueuedAt}`                 |
| `setDefaultEngine/getDefaultEngine/resetDefaultEngine`, `setConnectionPriorities/getConnectionPriority/resetConnectionPriorities`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | functions | —                                                                                                        |
| Types: `JobCore/Job<T>/AnyJob`, `DefineJobOptions`, `JobExecutionContext{id, queue, attempt, input, logger}`, `JobNext`, `JobMiddleware`, `UniqueJobOptions`, `StandardSchema`, `QueuedJobRecord`, `EngineFailure`, `JobEvent ("processing"\|"retrying"\|"processed"\|"failed")`, `JobEventPayload`, `JobCipher`, `JobReleaseError{delayMs}`, `BatchCancelledError{batchId}` | types     | —                                                                                                        |

## 15. `@kwiva/cli` (v0.3.0) — `kwiva` binary [#15-kwivacli-v030--kwiva-binary]

### Command domain [#command-domain]

| Symbol                                                      | Kind      | Signature                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineCommand(options)`                                    | function  | → `CommandDefinition{name, description?, options?{key: CommandOption}, handler(options)}` |

# Runtime Lifecycle (/docs/research/runtime-lifecycle)



# Runtime Lifecycle [#runtime-lifecycle]

**Sources:** `packages/core/src/app/*` (defineApp, assembleApp, discover), `packages/core/src/config/loader.ts`, `packages/core/src/config/env.ts`, `packages/cli/src/server/config-sections.ts` (`applyConfigSections`, `loadAppConfig`), `packages/http/src/server/*` (createServer/bootApp/mountRoutes), `packages/http/src/pipeline/*`, `packages/ui/src/render/server.ts`, `packages/data/src/dialect/config.ts`.

***

## 1. App boot (in order) [#1-app-boot-in-order]

1. `kwiva create <name>` — scaffolds `bootstrap/app.ts` (`defineApp({name})`), `src/config/{app,database,cache,kv,storage,mcp}.ts`, `src/app/models/`, `src/app/http/controllers/`, `src/database/{migrations,seeders}/`, `package.json` scripts (`dev/build/test`).
2. `loadConfig("src/config", root, env())` — loads `src/config/*.ts` files (section key = filename), merges `BUILT_IN_DEFAULTS` (app `{port:3000, host:"localhost"}`, logger `{level:"info", sink:"console"}`, cache `{driver:"memory", prefix:"kwiva", defaultTtl:60000, tags:true, swrGraceMs:60000}`, kv `{driver:"memory", namespace:"app", defaultTtl:300000}`) → files → env (`APP_PORT`, `DATABASE_URL`, `DATABASE_POOL_MAX`, …). `runValidators` (core `validate()` checks `app.port` int, `logger.level` enum) + section validators (auth, jobs, client, events, storage, mail, mcp, search) happen via `applyConfigSections(config)`.
3. `applyConfigSections(config)` — validates auth/jobs/client sections, calls `setMailConfig`, `setEventsConfig`, `initCache`, `initKv`, `initStorage`, `validateSearchConfig`, `validateMcpConfig`; `database` → `configureDatabase` (data runtime, PGLite/Postgres via Kysely + Bun.SQL dialect).
4. `assembleApp(defineAppResult, root)` — `discoverUnits` (models/services/policies/jobs/events/tasks/commands/controllers/middleware flat-scan, pages recursive), `registerPolicies` (exports ending in `Policy`/`Gate` from `policies/`), `pagesFromRegistry`.
5. `createServer({port})` → `AppServer`. `bootApp(server, {controllers, middlewareGroups, models, macros, resolvers, appCtx, openAPI})` → binds route ids, expands macros, mounts routes, mounts WS, `mountAutoRoutes` (data `restRoutes` per model), `assembleManifest`, `mountOpenAPI` (Scalar). Returns `ManifestEntry[]`.
6. `start(port?)` → server listens; `url` getter returns base.

***

## 2. Request pipeline (Elysia → before → handler → after → error) [#2-request-pipeline-elysia--before--handler--after--error]

For every incoming request to a controller route (simplified from `http/pipeline/{input,binding,before-handle,after-handle,error-map}.ts`):

1. **Input extraction** (`parseCookies`, `splitInput` — destructures `params/query/body/headers/cookies` per `RouteDefinition.input`).
2. **Validate** (`validateInput` → `parsePart` — Standard Schema per part; issues → `ValidationError` with field-mapped `fields`; `guard`/`group` scopes run their `before` via macro/`setup`).
3. **Before middleware** (`compileBeforeHandle` — global → controller → group → route middleware stack, in order; `CONTINUE` symbol short-circuits; exceptions → error map).
4. **Handler** (`wrapHandler`) — typed `ctx` (`HttpContext`): `.input`, `.params`, `.headers()`, `.setHeaders()`, `.json/.text/.noContent`, `.redirect()`, `.waitUntil()`, `.stream()`. `ctx.can` ambient ability map.
5. **After middleware** (`compileAfterHandle`).
6. **Output validation** — `validateOutput(schema, value)`; response shape per `RouteDefinition.contract`.
7. **Error mapping** (`toErrorResponse(error)`) — KwivaError → `{error: {code, message, requestId?, fields?}}` with HTTP status via `statusFor(code)`; non-KwivaError → 500 `INTERNAL`.

`AppServer.handle(request): Promise<Response>` — routing via `findRoute` reverse map (`routeUrl` for generating URLs from manifests), 404 via parameterless response, method mismatch via Elysia defaults.

***

## 3. WS/SSE [#3-wssse]

* **Upgrade** (`websocket/upgrade.ts`) — policy-checked via `createChannelHandle({getSession, onCleanup}).subscribe(topic)`; `awaitFn` until `open`.
* **Broadcast** (`broadcast`) — in-process hub; `subscribe(topic, sink)` returns unsubscribe; `topicCount`.
* **Presence** — `Presence{pattern, onJoin, onLeave, room(key), join, leave, members}` + `createPresenceHandle`.
* **SSE** (`stream/`, `streamPage`) — `StreamController{lastEventId, closed, enqueue, close}`; `SSE_HEADERS` content-type `text/event-stream`; `startHeartbeat` optional; `frame(id, event, data)`.

***

## 4. Jobs/Tasks/Scheduler [#4-jobstasksscheduler]

* `dispatch(job, input, opts)` → record id; `dispatchSync` → attempt; `startWorker({queues, concurrency, pollMs, ...})` → `WorkerHandle`; `startScheduler({tasks, tickMs, timezone})` → `{tick, stop}`; `parseCron`/`nextRun`; `defineTask` runs in event-loop context via `runTask`.

## 5. Global error handling + after-response [#5-global-error-handling--after-response]

* `toErrorResponse` maps the 8-code taxonomy to HTTP statuses; `mapError` covers `STORAGE_*`/`SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED` → storage/search 404s.
* `afterResponse(task)` — after-response queue for `dispatchAfterResponse` jobs.


# Terminology Glossary (/docs/research/terminology-glossary)



# Terminology Glossary [#terminology-glossary]

Canonical definitions for Kwiva terms — **always use these exact terms and meanings** in every doc page. This file is the source of truth; `core-concepts/definex.mdx`, `api/*.mdx`, and all concept pages must use the same language.

| Term                   | Definition                                                                                                                         | Where defined (source) |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| **Kwiva**              | The batteries-included TypeScript application framework.                                                                           | `framework/README.md`  |
| **DefineX**            | The single grammar convention — one `defineX` factory for every app-facing construct.                                              | core                   |
| **Factory**            | A declarative, serializable construct function (`defineModel`, `defineController`, …).                                             | core                   |
| **Engine**             | The machine running an app: Kwiva owns engine packages (`kysely`, `elysia`, `better-auth`, …); hidden from app code by lint gates. | core                   |
| **Package**            | The public units `@kwiva/*` app code imports (19 packages).                                                                        | core                   |
| **Sealed**             | Engine packages are `sealed` — app code may not import them.                                                                       | core                   |
| **`defineApp`**        | Application composition factory — wires models, controllers, middleware, services, pages, jobs, events, commands.                  | core                   |
| **`defineModel`**      | Data model factory — one source of truth; derives schema, migrations, REST, client, MCP, audit.                                    | data                   |
| **`defineController`** | HTTP controller factory — routes + handlers.                                                                                       | http                   |
| **`defineContract`**   | Typed request/response contract.                                                                                                   | http                   |
| **`defineMiddleware`** | Middleware factory.                                                                                                                | http                   |
| **`definePage`**       | Frontend page factory (`@kwiva/ui`).                                                                                               | ui                     |
| **`defineJob`**        | Background job factory (`@kwiva/jobs`).                                                                                            | jobs                   |
| **`defineTask`**       | Scheduled task factory.                                                                                                            | jobs                   |
| **`defineEvent`**      | Pub/sub event factory (`@kwiva/events`).                                                                                           | events                 |
| **`defineListener`**   | Event listener factory.                                                                                                            | events                 |
| **`defineSubscriber`** | Subscriber factory.                                                                                                                | events                 |
| **`defineMail`**       | Mail factory (`@kwiva/mail`).                                                                                                      | mail                   |
| **`defineMcpTool`**    | MCP tool factory.                                                                                                                  | mcp                    |
| **`definePolicy`**     | Authorization policy factory.                                                                                                      | auth                   |
| **`defineGate`**       | Gate factory (public hook only).                                                                                                   | auth                   |
| **Model IR**           | `ModelDefinition` — serialized intermediate representation.                                                                        | data                   |
| **Derivation**         | IR → artifacts (schema, migrations, REST, client, MCP…).                                                                           | core+data              |
| **Discovery**          | Convention-based registration via `src/app/**` globs.                                                                              | core                   |
| **Dispatch**           | `dispatch`/`dispatchSync`/`dispatchChain`/`dispatchBatch` — putting jobs into the queue.                                           | jobs                   |
| **Worker**             | `startWorker` loop; drains queue.                                                                                                  | jobs                   |
| **Scheduler**          | `startScheduler`/`parseCron` — cron-based runs.                                                                                    | jobs                   |
| **Cron**               | 5-field expression; Kwiva supports `@yearly`…`@minutely` macros.                                                                   | jobs                   |
| **Outbox**             | Transactional events-to-jobs queue (`enqueueOutbox`/`drainOutbox`).                                                                | jobs                   |
| **Contract**           | Typed input/output contract on routes.                                                                                             | http                   |
| **Middleware**         | Global/group/route pipeline stage.                                                                                                 | http                   |
| **SSR**                | Server-side rendering by Kwiva-owned orchestrator.                                                                                 | ui                     |
| **Island**             | Client-hydrated component in SSR pages.                                                                                            | ui                     |
| **`defineContract`**   | (see Contract)                                                                                                                     | http                   |
| **Cache**              | `Cache` class / `initCache` (Keyv v6 sealed, tags, TTL).                                                                           | core                   |
| **KV**                 | `Kv` class / `initKv` (Keyv v6 sealed, namespaces).                                                                                | core                   |
| **Store**              | Raw key-value store abstraction; drivers: memory, file, sqlite, redis, postgres.                                                   | core                   |
| **Storage**            | `Storage` class/`initStorage` (files-sdk disks).                                                                                   | storage                |
| **Disk**               | `Disk` instance — one configured filesystem-like storage.                                                                          | storage                |
| **Signed URL**         | Token-based public URL with expiry.                                                                                                | storage                |
| **Tenancy**            | `TenancyConfig` — multi-tenant access rules.                                                                                       | data                   |
| **Scope**              | `QueryBuilder.scope/withoutGlobalScopes`.                                                                                          | data                   |
| **Standard Schema**    | Shared validation schema interface (`StandardSchema`).                                                                             | core                   |
| **ValidationError**    | HTTP 422-class; `fields` = field-mapped issues.                                                                                    | core/http              |
| **ErrorCode**          | The 8-code taxonomy (BAD\_REQUEST…STORAGE\_TENANT\_REQUIRED).                                                                      | core                   |
| **Client**             | `@kwiva/client` — TanStack Query + Eden adapter; `initClient`.                                                                     | client                 |
| **FormData**           | (for `useUpload`) — multipart body.                                                                                                | client                 |
| **WASM?** (avoid)      | —                                                                                                                                  | —                      |
| **Route tree**         | Generated `src/.kwiva/types/route-tree.gen.ts` (TS-only typing).                                                                   | cli/ui                 |
| **Session**            | `Session` — auth session state (core ALS + auth).                                                                                  | auth                   |
| **AuthScope**          | `Symbol.for("kwiva.authScope")` ambient scope.                                                                                     | core/auth              |
| **`defineMcpTool`**    | (see MCP Tool)                                                                                                                     | mcp                    |
| **Transport**          | Sealed destination/transport for an async "send" — `Transport` on Mail; jobs go to QueueEngine.                                    | mail/jobs              |
| **Cron macro**         | e.g. `@yearly`, `@minutely` (supported).                                                                                           | jobs                   |
