# How do I connect AI via MCP? (/guides/mcp)



# Connect AI via MCP [#connect-ai-via-mcp]

## Enable [#enable]

```ts title="src/config/mcp.ts"
export default defineConfig({
  enabled: true,
  route: "/mcp",
  transport: "streamable", // or "stdio"
  models: ["Todo"],
  controllers: ["TodosController"],
});
```

## Connect [#connect]

```json title="~/.cursor/mcp.json"
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "kwiva": {
      "url": "http://localhost:3000/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

For stdio mode: `{ "command": "kwiva", "args": ["mcp"] }`.

## Test [#test]

Use `kwiva mcp:print-config` for agent config, or connect to an MCP client.

## Custom tools [#custom-tools]

`defineMcpTool` — see [Tool Generation](/docs/ai-mcp/tool-generation).

> \[!TIP]
> MCP runs through the framework — the tools are policy-checked (`ability`).


# How do I generate OpenAPI docs? (/guides/openapi)



# Generate OpenAPI [#generate-openapi]

## Enable [#enable]

```bash title="terminal"
bun run dev
```

OpenAPI is auto-generated:

1. `bootApp` — `assembleManifest` from routes
2. `mountOpenAPI(app, manifest)` — mounts `/openapi.json` + `/docs`

## Shape [#shape]

`OpenAPIOptions`: `{title, version, description, path (default "/openapi.json"), specPath, documentation, exclude}`.

## CLI: `kwiva build` [#cli-kwiva-build]

Regenerates manifest + route-tree; OpenAPI is runtime-derived from the manifest.

> \[!TIP]
> Try `curl http://localhost:3000/openapi.json` or `/docs`.


# How do I paginate results? (/guides/pagination)



# Paginate Results [#paginate-results]

## Offset [#offset]

```ts
await Todo.page(1, { size: 20 }).where("status", "pending").all();
```

Response envelope: `{ items, page, size, total, pages }`.

## Cursor [#cursor]

```ts
await Todo.cursor("id", "todos", { limit: 50 }).all();
```

Response: `{ items, cursor, hasMore }`.

## Client [#client]

```tsx
const { items, loadNext, hasNext } = useInfiniteList("TodosController.list");
```

## Notes [#notes]

* Use cursor for high-volume/frequently updated collections (chats, feeds).
* Offset for dashboards/admin views.


# How do I add a policy? (/guides/policies)



# Add Policies [#add-policies]

```ts title="src/app/policies/post.ts"
import { definePolicy, defineGate } from "@kwiva/auth";

export const PostPolicy = definePolicy({
  delete(user, post) { return user?.id === post.authorId; },
  edit(user, post) { return user?.id === post.authorId && !post.published; },
  read(user) { return user?.role === "admin" || true; },
});

export const PostGate = defineGate((user) => user?.role === "admin");
```

## Wire to routes [#wire-to-routes]

```ts
api.get("/:id", (ctx) => ctx.store.posts.find(ctx.params.id));
```

## Check via `ctx.can` [#check-via-ctxcan]

```ts
import { can } from "@kwiva/auth";
if (can(PostPolicy, ctx.user, "delete", post)) { /* allow */ }
```

## Gating on generated routes [#gating-on-generated-routes]

`model.options.permission` — Kwiva checks `ctx.can` for each route.

> \[!TIP]
> Add to `defineApp` via `policies: [PostPolicy]` — auto-discovery from `src/app/policies/`.


# How do I protect a route? (/guides/protect-routes)



# Protect Routes [#protect-routes]

## `requireAuth()` — session/user attach [#requireauth--sessionuser-attach]

```ts title="src/app/http/controllers/private.ts"
export const PrivateController = defineController({
  prefix: "/api/private",
  middleware: [requireAuth()],
  routes(api) {
    api.get("/", async (ctx) => {
      authorize(PrivatePolicy, ctx.user, "read");
      return ctx.store.private.all();
    });
  },
});
```

## `guestOnly({redirectTo})` — for public routes [#guestonlyredirectto--for-public-routes]

```ts
export const AuthController = defineController({
  routes(api) {
    api.get("/signin", () => redirect("/"), {
      middleware: [guestOnly()],
    });
  },
});
```

## Page-level protection [#page-level-protection]

```tsx
export default definePage({
  beforeLoad: async (ctx) => {
    const session = await getSession(ctx.request);
    if (!session) redirect("/signin");
  },
});
```

## Client usage [#client-usage]

```tsx
const { session, user } = useSession();
```

> \[!TIP]
> 401 = missing session, 403 = forbidden. Kwiva uses both.


# How do I enable realtime? (/guides/realtime)



# Enable Realtime [#enable-realtime]

## 1. Define a channel [#1-define-a-channel]

```ts title="src/app/http/ws/channels.ts"
import { channel } from "@kwiva/http";
export const TodoUpdates = channel("todos.updates").policy((user) => !!user);
```

## 2. Hook to events [#2-hook-to-events]

```ts title="src/app/events/todo-updated.ts"
import { defineEvent, broadcast } from "@kwiva/events";
export const TodoUpdated = defineEvent<{ id: string; title: string }>({
  broadcastOn: { module: "todos" },
  broadcastAs: "todos.updated",
});
```

## 3. Client [#3-client]

```tsx
import { useWsSubscription } from "@kwiva/client";
const { data, error, status } = useWsSubscription("TodosUpdates");
```

## 4. Broadcast from server [#4-broadcast-from-server]

```ts
export function broadcastUpdate(todo) { broadcast("todos.updates", todo); }
```

> \[!TIP]
> For non-WS events: [Client-Side Realtime](/docs/realtime/client-usage).


# How do I schedule a task? (/guides/schedule-tasks)



# Schedule Tasks [#schedule-tasks]

```ts title="src/app/tasks/cleanup-old-todos.ts"
import { defineTask } from "@kwiva/jobs";

export const CleanupOldTodos = defineTask({
  schedule: "0 2 * * *",
  description: "Delete todos older than 30 days",
  preventOverlapping: true,
  handler: async ({ logger }) => {
    logger.info("cleanup.started");
    // cleanup logic
  },
});
```

## Scheduler setup [#scheduler-setup]

```ts title="src/bootstrap/app.ts"
import { startScheduler } from "@kwiva/jobs";
startScheduler({ tasks: [CleanupOldTodos] });
```

## Cron [#cron]

* 5-field format (`*`, `*/5`, `0 2 * * *`)
* Macros: `@yearly`, `@monthly`, `@weekly`, `@daily`, `@hourly`, `@minutely`
* Timezone via config (`timezone: "America/New_York"`)

## Notes [#notes]

* `preventOverlapping` — skips overlapping runs
* Manual run: `runTask(CleanupOldTodos)`
* Test via `tick()` on `startScheduler` or `runTask`

> \[!TIP]
> `parseCron` for preflighting schedules (see [Jobs API](/api/jobs#scheduler)).


# How do I configure tenancy? (/guides/tenancy)



# Configure Tenancy [#configure-tenancy]

```ts title="src/config/database.ts"
export default defineConfig({
  driver: "pglite",
  tenancy: {
    defaults: {
      mode: "path",
      tenantField: "tenant_id",
      models: "*",
      cache: { scoped: true },
      storage: { scoped: true },
    },
  },
});
```

## Modes [#modes]

| Mode     | URL style         | Notes                        |
| -------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `none`   | —                 | track only                   |
| `fixed`  | —                 | everyone = 1                 |
| `path`   | `/t/<id>/*`       | **recommended for web apps** |
| `header` | `X-Tenant` header | reverse-proxy configured     |
| `org`    | —                 | hierarchical                 |
| `domain` | tenant in domain  | hosting-specific             |

## Behavior [#behavior]

* Auto-scoped queries (via `tenantField`)
* Storage/cache prefixing via `currentTenant()`

> \[!TIP]
> For isolation via `runWithTenant({tenantId})`: see [Tenancy Resolution](/docs/tenancy/resolution).


# How do I write app tests? (/guides/testing)



# Write App Tests [#write-app-tests]

```ts
import { withApp, createTestClient } from "@kwiva/testing";

describe("TodosController", () => {
  await withApp(async ({ server }) => {
    const client = await createTestClient(server);
    const res = await client.Todos.create({ title: "Test" });
    expect(res.data.title).toBe("Test");
  });
});
```

## Patterns [#patterns]

| API                           | Purpose                                |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `withApp(fn)`                 | boots app in-process, tears down after |
| `createTestClient(server)`    | typed client for in-process requests   |
| `bootAppFromRoot(opts?)`      | manual boot for advanced flows         |
| `setupTestDb(models)`         | in-memory PGLite for DB tests          |
| `fakeQueue()`, `fakeEvents()` | event system fakes                     |

## Database tests [#database-tests]

```ts
setupTestDb([Todo]);
const todo = await Todo.create({ title: "x" });
```

> \[!TIP]
> For unit tests of services: `setupTestDb` + mock services, no HTTP.


# How do I validate input? (/guides/validate-input)



# Validate Input [#validate-input]

## 1. Field DSL (models) [#1-field-dsl-models]

```ts title="src/app/models/todo.ts"
import { defineModel } from "@kwiva/data";
export const Todo = defineModel("todos", (f) => ({
  title: f.string().validation((s) => s.min(1).max(200)),
  priority: f.integer().validation((i) => i >= 0 && i <= 10),
}));
```

## 2. Route-level validation [#2-route-level-validation]

```ts title="src/app/http/controllers/todos.ts"
api.post("/", async (ctx) => ctx.store.todos.create(ctx.input.body), {
  input: {
    body: CreateTodoBody, // Standard Schema
    params: ParamsSchema,
    query: QuerySchema,
  },
});
```

## 3. Contracts [#3-contracts]

`defineContract({request, response})` — see [Controllers](/docs/http/controllers#contract).

## Error shape [#error-shape]

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION",
    "message": "Invalid input",
    "fields": { "body.title": ["Too short"] },
    "requestId": "req_abc"
  }
}
```

> \[!TIP]
> Custom rules: `.validation((v) => new Error("Custom"))` — returns error on falsey.


# Deployment Architecture (/architecture/deployment-architecture)



# Deployment Architecture [#deployment-architecture]

* Build: `kwiva build` → `dist/` + `.kwiva/types/route-tree.gen.ts`
* Deploy targets: Node/Bun standalone, Docker/K8s, serverless
* Stateless by construction (external DB via Postgres)

See [Deployment](/docs/deployment/).


# Design Principles (/architecture/design-principles)



# Design Principles [#design-principles]

## Pillars [#pillars]

| Pillar                             | Meaning                                            |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| **Coherence over fragmentation**   | One grammar, one narrative.                        |
| **Framework-owned APIs**           | Kwiva owns the app surface; engines sealed behind. |
| **Type safety**                    | IR-driven types end-to-end.                        |
| **Convention through defineX**     | One grammar for all constructs.                    |
| **Batteries included, not forced** | Defaults with overrides.                           |

## ADRs [#adrs]

All decisions are ADR-documented in the framework repo (`docs/framework/adr/`):

| ADR      | Topic                         |
| -------- | ----------------------------- |
| ADR-0001 | Bun.serve                     |
| ADR-0002 | oRPC (legacy)                 |
| ADR-0003 | MikroORM (legacy)             |
| ADR-0004 | evlog                         |
| ADR-0005 | Vite (withdrawn)              |
| ADR-0006 | defineClient                  |
| ADR-0007 | defineController              |
| ADR-0008 | Laravel shape (defineService) |
| ADR-0009 | defineX                       |
| ADR-0010 | Kysely + PGLite + Bun.SQL     |
| ADR-0011 | Elysia                        |
| ADR-0012 | Eden + TanStack               |
| ADR-0013 | Convention assembly           |
| ADR-0014 | File-based routes             |
| ADR-0015 | defineContract                |
| ADR-0016 | Eden runtime                  |
| ADR-0017 | Soft navigation               |
| ADR-0018 | Files SDK storage             |
| ADR-0019 | Core cache + KV               |
| ADR-0020 | FTS search                    |
| ADR-0021 | MCP v2                        |
| ADR-0022 | Model IR                      |
| ADR-0023 | Laravel-shaped helpers        |
| ADR-0024 | Shared boot seam              |

See [research/feature-inventory](/docs/research/feature-inventory) for the active ADR list.


# Frontend Architecture (/architecture/frontend-architecture)



# Frontend Architecture [#frontend-architecture]

Kwiva owns SSR (ADR-0006):

```
GET /path
├── resolveRoute
├── layout.resolveLayouts
├── page.load (SSR)
└── renderPage → document
```

## Data flow [#data-flow]

`page.load` → props → `renderPage` → tree → hydrateApp.

## Types [#types]

Typed via `src/.kwiva/types/route-tree.gen.ts`.

## Next [#next]

See [Frontend](/docs/frontend/), [Rendering](/docs/rendering/).


# Architecture (/architecture)



# Architecture [#architecture]

## Core rule [#core-rule]

> The application depends only on the framework; the framework owns the engines.

```
Your app (src/) — models, http, pages, jobs, events, config
  ↓ writes defineX(...) only · imports only @kwiva/*
Framework API surface (@kwiva/* — the 19 packages)
  ↓
Sealed engines (framework-owned internals — never imported by app code)
  ↓
Runtime (Bun · Node · serverless · containers) via presets
```

## Design pillars [#design-pillars]

1. **One defineX grammar** — every app construct is a factory
2. **Framework-owned APIs** — framework owns lifecycle/types
3. **Type safety throughout** — typed routes, zero codegen
4. **Batteries included, not forced** — defaults + overrides

## Next [#next]

* [Design Principles](/architecture/design-principles)
* [Request Lifecycle](/architecture/request-lifecycle)
* [Model Derivation](/architecture/model-derivation)
* [Frontend Architecture](/architecture/frontend-architecture)
* [Deployment Architecture](/architecture/deployment-architecture)
* [Package Boundaries](/architecture/package-boundaries)


# Model Derivation (/architecture/model-derivation)



# Model Derivation [#model-derivation]

`defineModel` → `ModelDefinition` (IR) → artifacts:

| Artifact                     | Source                                          |
| ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| Database schema + migrations | `@kwiva/data` (`migrateGenerate`, `migrate`)    |
| REST routes                  | `@kwiva/http` (`restRoutes`, `mountAutoRoutes`) |
| Typed client                 | `@kwiva/client` (route tree + callRoute)        |
| MCP tools                    | `@kwiva/mcp` (`generateModelTools`)             |
| OpenAPI                      | `@kwiva/http` (`mountOpenAPI`)                  |
| Realtime broadcast           | `@kwiva/events` (`broadcastOn` metadata)        |

## No-drift guarantee [#no-drift-guarantee]

Single source: `src/app/models/*.ts` → IR → all derived artifacts.

See [advanced/model-ir](/docs/advanced/model-ir).


# Package Boundaries (/architecture/package-boundaries)



# Package Boundaries [#package-boundaries]

See [Advanced Package Boundaries](/docs/advanced/package-boundaries).

Full map: [research/architecture-inventory](/docs/research/architecture-inventory).


# Request Lifecycle (/architecture/request-lifecycle)



# Request Lifecycle [#request-lifecycle]

See [HTTP Lifecycle](/docs/http/lifecycle) + [Advanced Request Lifecycle](/docs/advanced/request-lifecycle).

## Step list (high-level) [#step-list-high-level]

1. Request arrives → Elysia
2. `buildCtx` (input parsing)
3. Input validation
4. Middleware stack (global → controller → group → route)
5. Handler
6. Output validation
7. Error mapping
8. Response (optional `waitUntil`, WS bridge)

## Guarantees [#guarantees]

* Ordered execution
* Tracing spans per step (via evlog)
* Request IDs in errors
* No retries unless configured

> \[!TIP]
> Advanced version: [Advanced Request Lifecycle](/docs/advanced/request-lifecycle).


# @kwiva/auth (/api/auth)



# @kwiva/auth [#kwivaauth]

Auth package: `defineAuth` providers, sessions, identity flows, `definePolicy`/`defineGate`, `requireAuth`, controllers, client hooks.

## Providers (`src/config/auth.ts`) [#providers-srcconfigauthts]

```ts
import { defineAuth, emailPassword, magicLink, oauth, validateAuthConfig } from "@kwiva/auth";

export default defineAuth({
  providers: [emailPassword(), oauth({ id: "google", clientId: process.env.GOOGLE_ID, clientSecret: process.env.GOOGLE_SECRET })],
  session: { secret: process.env.AUTH_SECRET, maxAge: 604800 },
  register: { createUser: async ({ email, password }) => ({ email, password }) },
});
```

| Provider                 | Notes                                        |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| `emailPassword()`        | password login/register, verification emails |
| `magicLink()`            | send-email token                             |
| `oauth(provider, {...})` | + PKCE where supported                       |

## Session (`src/config/auth.ts`) [#session-srcconfigauthts]

`AuthConfig{providers, session: {secret (non-empty), maxAge (positive), cookie?}, register?, remember?, rateLimit?, trustProxy?}` — `validateAuthConfig` throws on malformed shapes. Cookie defaults: `kwiva_session` (httpOnly, sameSite: lax, secure: false); `kwiva_remember` (365d).

## Middleware [#middleware]

| Factory                                                               | Notes                                         |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `requireAuth({secret?, maxAge?, cookie?, store?, users?, policies?})` | attaches `ctx.session`, `ctx.user`, `ctx.can` |
| `guestOnly({redirectTo?})`                                            | redirects authed users                        |
| `verified({isVerified?, message?})`                                   | 403 unless email verified                     |
| `apiTokenAuth({resolve, header?, can?, message?})`                    | token-based (`parseBearer`)                   |
| `passwordConfirmation({secret?})`                                     | double-submit confirmation middleware         |

## Policies (`src/app/policies/*.ts`) [#policies-srcapppoliciests]

| API                                                                           | Notes                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `definePolicy({view: () => true})`                                            | deny-by-default; `defineGate(check)` — `authorize(policy, user, action, resource?)`, `authorizeGate(gate, user, resource?)` |
| `can/cannot`, `authorize`, `authorizeGate`, `whereCan`                        | ambient (ALS) + explicit overloads                                                                                          |
| Registry: `registerPolicies/resetDefaultRegistry/policyFor/normalizeRegistry` | auto-merged from `policiesFromModules` at discovery                                                                         |

## Identity flows [#identity-flows]

| Flow               | API                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Password reset     | `createPasswordReset({secret, ttlSeconds})` → `{request(email), verify(token), reset(token, password)}`                                   |
| Email verification | `createEmailVerifier({secret, ttlSeconds})` → `{tokenFor, send, verify, inspect}` + `isEmailVerified(user)`                               |
| Magic link         | `createMagicLink({secret})` → `{send(email), verify(token)}`                                                                              |
| TOTP               | `generateTotpSecret(), totpCode(secret, {at?, digits?, window?}), verifyTotp, totpUri(...)` + `generateRecoveryCodes/consumeRecoveryCode` |
| API tokens         | `generateApiToken(prefix = "kwiva_")`, `hashApiToken`, `verifyApiToken`, `parseBearer`, `authorizeHeader`                                 |
| PKCE OAuth         | `createPkcePair()`, `createOAuthClient({...})` → `{authorizationUrl, exchangeCode, fetchProfile}`                                         |

## Controllers [#controllers]

`createAuthController()` → routes `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/register`; `createSessionController()` → `GET /session` (with `requireAuth`); `sessionController` (zero-arg).

## Client hooks (React) [#client-hooks-react]

| Hook                                | Notes                                        |
| ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `useSession(endpoint = "/session")` | → `{session, user, isLoading, refresh}`      |
| `useCan(ability)`                   | ALS + ambient abilities; `AbilitiesProvider` |
| `setAmbientAbilities(map)`          | —                                            |

## Client-side flows (during login) [#client-side-flows-during-login]

Session/token flows: browser reads `kwiva_session` cookie → `useSession()`; login redirects; `requireAuth`-protected pages redirect.

> \[!TIP]
> Built-in session store is per-process (`createMemorySessionStore`). For multi-instance: cookie-only (HMAC signatures) or JWT-based stores.


# @kwiva/cli (/api/cli)



# @kwiva/cli [#kwivacli]

The `kwiva` binary (`bin/kwiva` → `src/index.ts`; `import.meta.main` guard).

## Framework commands (dispatch order) [#framework-commands-dispatch-order]

| Command                                          | Syntax                      | Behavior                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `create <name>`                                  | `kwiva create my-app`       | Validated name (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`); refuses if exists. Scaffolds `bootstrap/`, `src/config/{app,database,cache,kv,storage,mcp}.ts`, `src/app/models/`, `src/app/http/controllers/`, `src/database/{migrations,seeders}/`, `package.json` (scripts `dev/build/test`) |
| `dev`                                            | `kwiva dev [--port <n>]`    | Dev server. `--port` default 3000; invalid → exit 1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `build`                                          | `kwiva build [--out <dir>]` | Bundles client entry + regenerates route tree (`src/.kwiva/entry.client.tsx`, `src/.kwiva/types/route-tree.gen.ts`). Logs `kwiva build → <outFile> (<routes> routes, <pages> pages)`                                                                                  |
| `test`                                           | `kwiva test [-- <args>]`    | Spawns `bun test` in app root; args after `--` pass through                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `migrate`                                        | —                           | Apply migrations from `src/database/migrations` (flat scan, name order)                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `migrate:status`                                 | —                           | `applied: …` / `pending: …`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `migrate:down`                                   | —                           | Roll back last batch                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `migrate:generate`                               | —                           | Generate DDL from model IR diff                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `seed`                                           | `kwiva seed [name]`         | Run all/one seeders from `src/database/seeders`                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `task <name>`                                    | —                           | Run task by name (`runTask`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `route:list`                                     | —                           | Print `METHOD  fullPath  routeId` lines                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `key:generate`                                   | —                           | Append `APP_KEY` to `.env` (0600, refuses overwrite)                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `storage:sync <from> <to> [--prune] [--dry-run]` | —                           | Copy objects between disks; skips unchanged; `--prune` deletes target-only; `--dry-run` reports                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `storage:clear [disk] [--force]`                 | —                           | Clear a disk (S3/GCS/Azure/Blob need `--force`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `search:reindex [model]`                         | —                           | Requires `database` section                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `mcp`                                            | —                           | Serve MCP on stdio (auth forced `none`) — generated model + controller tools + custom tools from `src/app/mcp/tools/`                                                                                                                                                 |
| `mcp:print-config`                               | —                           | Print agent config JSON                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `doctor`                                         | —                           | Validate storage/search/mcp; exit 1 on failure                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `help` / `none` / `--help`                       | —                           | Prints HELP + `App commands:` list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

**App commands** (`defineCommand`, from `src/app/commands/`) are discovered and listed after framework commands — discoverable via `loadAppCommands`.

## Generators (`kwiva make:<kind> <Name>`) [#generators-kwiva-makekind-name]

| Kind         | Target                     | Ext    | Dated? | Suffix       |
| ------------ | -------------------------- | ------ | ------ | ------------ |
| `config`     | `src/config`               | `.ts`  | —      | —            |
| `service`    | `src/app/services`         | `.ts`  | —      | `Service`    |
| `model`      | `src/app/models`           | `.ts`  | —      | —            |
| `controller` | `src/app/http/controllers` | `.ts`  | —      | `Controller` |
| `middleware` | `src/app/http/middleware`  | `.ts`  | —      | `Middleware` |
| `contract`   | `src/app/http/contracts`   | `.ts`  | —      | `Contract`   |
| `policy`     | `src/app/policies`         | `.ts`  | —      | `Policy`     |
| `gate`       | `src/app/policies`         | `.ts`  | —      | `Gate`       |
| `job`        | `src/app/jobs`             | `.ts`  | —      | `Job`        |
| `task`       | `src/app/tasks`            | `.ts`  | —      | `Task`       |
| `event`      | `src/app/events`           | `.ts`  | —      | `Event`      |
| `listener`   | `src/app/events`           | `.ts`  | —      | `Listener`   |
| `mail`       | `src/app/mail`             | `.ts`  | —      | `Mail`       |
| `factory`    | `src/database/factories`   | `.ts`  | —      | `Factory`    |
| `migration`  | `src/database/migrations`  | `.ts`  | ✅      | `Migration`  |
| `seeder`     | `src/database/seeders`     | `.ts`  | —      | `Seeder`     |
| `page`       | `src/ui/pages`             | `.tsx` | —      | `Page`       |
| `mcp-tool`   | `src/app/mcp/tools`        | `.ts`  | —      | `Tool`       |
| `command`    | `src/app/commands`         | `.ts`  | —      | `Command`    |

Behavior: refuses overwrites, `created <path>` output. Templates are minimal valid `defineX` bodies (e.g. `defineController({prefix: "/${base}", routes: (api) => api.get("/", () => ({ok: true}))})`).

## DefineCommand — app commands [#definecommand--app-commands]

```ts title="src/app/commands/deploy.ts"
import { defineCommand } from "@kwiva/cli";
export const DeployCommand = defineCommand({
  name: "deploy",
  description: "Deploy the app",
  options: { stage: { type: "option", default: "production" } },
  handler(options) {
    console.log(options.stage);
  },
});
```

### Parsing [#parsing]

| Syntax                          | Parsed as                                    |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `--name=value` / `--name value` | option value                                 |
| `--flag`                        | `true`; `--flag=false` for false             |
| `-h` / `--help`                 | generated help (exit 0)                      |
| positional args                 | `errors` entry (`unexpected argument "..."`) |

### Option resolution [#option-resolution]

`optionKind(option)`: explicit `type` wins; else boolean default → `flag`, string default or required → `option`. Defaults applied; missing required → error.

## Codegen [#codegen]

| API                                                  | Notes                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `collectRoutes(root)`                                | → `CollectedRoute[]{id, method, path, params[], input{params?,query?,body?}, output, isWS}` |
| `collectPages(root)`                                 | → `CollectedPage[]`                                                                         |
| `scanLayoutFiles(root)`                              | → `src/ui/layouts` paths                                                                    |
| `writeRouteTree(root)`                               | → `src/.kwiva/types/route-tree.gen.ts`                                                      |
| `emitClientEntry(pages, layouts, clientConfigPath?)` | generated `src/.kwiva/entry.client.tsx`                                                     |

## Library exports [#library-exports]

`loadAppConfig(root)`, `applyConfigSections(config)`, `buildClientBundle(root, {minify, outDir})`, `discoverPageFiles(root)`, `bootDevServer(root, {port?, clientScript?, skipBuild?})`, `emitServeFile()`, `bumpGeneration/readGeneration`, `loadAppCommands(root?)`, `dispatchAppCommand(root, argv)`, `main(argv)`, `runMake(root, cmd, argv)`, `planConstruct(kind, name)`, `writeConstruct(root, kind, name)`, `MAKE_KINDS`, `introspect(schema)`, `loadAppCommands`.

> \[!TIP]
> `kwiva new` scaffolds a real Kwiva app — run `bun install` then `kwiva dev` (default port 3000).


# @kwiva/client (/api/client)



`@kwiva/client` is the typed RPC client for your application. It is scaffolded once as `src/client.ts` and derives its full shape from this app's controllers and models at the type level — the route manifest and model IR flow into ambient types under `src/.kwiva/types`, so there is no codegen step and no drift between the server contract and the client.

```ts title="kwiva-client.ts"
import { createClient } from '@kwiva/client'

export const client = createClient()
```

## createClient [#createclient]

`createClient` builds the typed client for the current app.

```ts title="createclient.ts"
const client = createClient()
const apiClient = createClient({ baseUrl: '/api' })
```

| Option    | Type     | Description                                                       |
| --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | API base the browser client targets when it cannot run in-process |

| Behavior    | Description                                                                 |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Server-side | Calls run in-process (no network) and dedupe per request                    |
| Browser     | Calls the same-origin API with session cookies flowing automatically        |
| Types       | End-to-end: model → route → client, resolved from the manifest and model IR |

## Model Endpoints [#model-endpoints]

Each model generates exactly five deterministic routes — `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete` — plus any custom controller actions. The client mirrors them under the model's resource name.

```ts title="model-endpoints.ts"
const { data, total } = await client.users.list({ where: { role: 'admin' }, page: 1 })
const user = await client.users.get('usr_01h2x8kq9f4m3p6t7y2wv0ba')
const created = await client.users.create({ name: 'Ada L.', role: 'admin' })
const updated = await client.users.update('usr_01h2x8kq9f4m3p6t7y2wv0ba', { name: 'Ada L.' })
await client.users.delete('usr_01h2x8kq9f4m3p6t7y2wv0ba')
```

| Method   | Signature (resolved from model IR)                                 | Description                                            |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `list`   | `(input?: ListInput) => Promise<{ data: Model[]; total: number }>` | Filtered, paginated listing                            |
| `get`    | `(id) => Promise<{ data: Model } \| { error: ApiError }>`          | Single record by id                                    |
| `create` | `(input) => Promise<{ data: Model } \| { error: ApiError }>`       | Create with validated fields                           |
| `update` | `(id, patch) => Promise<{ data: Model } \| { error: ApiError }>`   | Partial update by id                                   |
| `delete` | `(id) => Promise<...>`                                             | Delete by id; soft-deletes when the model enables them |

List input is typed from the model: `where` filters match queryable fields, `page` drives offset pagination, and `orderBy` accepts sortable columns. The exact member names follow your model definitions — every input and resolved value is inferred, not annotated.

Errors are part of the resolved type: calls return a discriminated union of the success envelope and `{ error: ApiError }`, so narrowing an error is a type-level operation.

```ts title="model-endpoints-2.ts"
const result = await client.posts.get(id)

if (result.error) {
  console.log(result.error.code, result.error.message)
  return
}

console.log(result.data.title)
```

## Custom Controller Actions [#custom-controller-actions]

Actions declared on controllers become methods alongside the generated model endpoints. `defineController` bodies, params, and schemas shape the client, so a route handler surfaces as a typed callable.

```ts title="custom-controller-actions.ts"
await client.posts.publish('pst_01h2x8kq9f4m3p6t7y2wv0ba')
```

Path params, bodies, and query arguments of the action are typed from the controller route's schemas, and the action returns the same envelope-and-error union as model endpoints.

## Typed Errors [#typed-errors]

Failures across every call resolve to a typed error rather than an untyped throw:

| Field     | Type             | Description                                    |
| --------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `code`    | `string`         | Stable machine-readable error code             |
| `message` | `string`         | Human-readable message                         |
| `issues`  | array (optional) | Validation issues when input failed validation |

```ts title="typed-errors.ts"
const result = await client.users.create({ name: '' })

if (result.error) {
  if (result.error.issues) {
    return result.error.issues
  }
  return result.error.message
}
```

See [Errors](/docs/http/errors) for the server-side contract that produces these responses.

## Subscriptions [#subscriptions]

`client.stream` opens a typed subscription on a resource or channel and returns an async iterable of typed events. WebSocket is the primary transport; when WebSocket is unavailable the client transparently falls back to SSE (v1.x).

```ts title="subscriptions.ts"
const stream = client.chat.stream({ roomId })

for await (const event of stream) {
  console.log(event)
}
```

Server-side, events are pushed to the channel via the channel API and broadcasting. See [Channels](/docs/realtime/channels) and [Events & Broadcasting](/docs/realtime/events).

## SSR-Safe Behavior [#ssr-safe-behavior]

The same `client` module runs on the server and in the browser without special-casing:

* During SSR, calls execute **in-process** — no network hop — and dedupe within a request.
* Loaders use the typed client directly; their results serialize into the page and rehydrate into the data-hook cache on the client, so server and browser agree without a second fetch.
* On the browser, calls go to the same-origin API and resolve into the same cache.

This is what lets page loaders, navigation preloads, and data hooks share one cache. See [Loaders & Data](/docs/frontend/loaders) and [Hydration](/docs/rendering/hydration).

## Sessions & CSRF [#sessions--csrf]

The client is session-aware by default:

* Session cookies flow automatically on every browser request; nothing is stored or attached by hand.
* The CSRF token is handled by the provider that mounts the client — in an `@kwiva/react` app, `Providers` handles the client-side token wiring.
* In-process (SSR and test) calls carry the request session directly and bypass browser CSRF concerns.

See [Sessions](/docs/auth/sessions) and [Protecting Routes](/docs/auth/protecting-routes).

## createTestClient [#createtestclient]

`createTestClient` (from `@kwiva/testing`) returns the same typed client bound to a real app instance, running in-process with no network. It is typically used inside the `withApp` harness, which boots the app, migrates, and seeds per test.

```ts title="createtestclient.ts"
import { withApp, createTestClient } from '@kwiva/testing'

test('posts CRUD', withApp(async (app) => {
  const client = createTestClient(app)

  const created = await client.posts.create({ title: 'First' })
  const { data, total } = await client.posts.list({ where: { title: 'First' } })
}))
```

| Option   | Description                                                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `tenant` | Runs the client against a specific tenant for tenancy-scoped tests |

The test client is fully typed, so type expectations from `@kwiva/client` hold in tests:

```ts title="createtestclient-2.ts"
expectTypeOf(client.posts.list({})).resolves.toMatchTypeOf<{ data: Post[]; total: number }>()
expectTypeOf(client.users.get('x')).resolves.toMatchTypeOf<{ data: User } | { error: ApiError }>()
```

See [API Testing](/docs/testing/api-testing) and [Integration Testing](/docs/testing/integration-testing).

## What to Read Next [#what-to-read-next]

* [RPC Client](/docs/frontend/rpc-client) — Scaffolding and usage in an app
* [Type Inference](/docs/core-concepts/type-inference) — How end-to-end types flow
* [Data Hooks](/docs/frontend/data-hooks) — Consuming the client through hooks
* [Controllers](/docs/http/controllers) — The server surface the client types against
* [Errors](/docs/http/errors) — Typed error contract
* [Client-Side Realtime](/docs/realtime/client-usage) — Channel hooks and SSE fallback
* [`@kwiva/ui`](/api/ui) — `definePage`, `Providers`, and pages/navigation


# @kwiva/core (/api/core)



# @kwiva/core [#kwivacore]

The application kernel — app composition, config, context/ALS, errors, logger, model IR, cache, KV, store, and helper/collection barrels.

## defineApp [#defineapp]

| Symbol                                | Kind     | Signature                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineApp(options)`                  | function | → `AppDefinition{name, models?, controllers?, middleware?, services?, policies?, pages?, jobs?, events?, commands?, macros?, state?, decorate?, resolve?}` (additive arrays) |
| `assembleApp(app, root?)`             | function | → `UnitRegistry` (discovery + merge)                                                                                                                                         |
| `defineService(factory)`              | function | `(factory: (ctx: {context: AppContext}) => T) => ServiceFactory<T>`                                                                                                          |
| `instantiateServices(factories, app)` | function | —                                                                                                                                                                            |

## Config [#config]

| Symbol                                                                 | Kind     | Signature                                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineConfig<T>(section): T`                                          | function | pass-through validator                                                                  |
| `loadConfig(dir?, root?, env?, validators?)`                           | function | discovers `src/config/*.ts`; merge defaults → files → env (`APP_PORT`, `DATABASE_URL`…) |
| `envVarFor(section, keyPath)`                                          | function | → upper-snake env name                                                                  |
| Types: `AppConfig{name?, port?, host?}`, `LoggerConfig{level?, sink?}` | types    | —                                                                                       |

## Context / ALS [#context--als]

| Symbol                                                                                                                        | Kind      | Signature            |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------- |
| `runWithAuth/currentAuth`, `runWithRequest/currentRequest`, `runWithBatch`, `runWithTenant/currentTenant`, `runInTransaction` | functions | ALS scopes           |
| `stashAuthScope/authScopeOf`, `createContext`, `createAppContext`                                                             | functions | —                    |
| `afterResponse(task)`, `flushAfterResponse()`, `hasAfterResponseScope()`, `runWithAfterResponse(fn)`                          | functions | after-response queue |
| Types: `AppContext, RequestContext, Session{id, userId, expiresAt, remember?}`                                                | types     | —                    |

## Errors [#errors]

| Symbol                                                                                               | Kind           | Signature       |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------- |
| `class KwivaError(code, message, options?)`, `error(code, message, data?)`                           | class/function | 8-code taxonomy |
| `NotFoundError, ForbiddenError, UnauthorizedError, ConflictError, ValidationError, RateLimitedError` | classes        | —               |
| `STORAGE_*` + `SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED` codes                                                          | const          | —               |

## Logger [#logger]

`class Logger{info/warn/error(msg, data?), child(bindings)}`, `createLogger(options?)`, `createContextLogger(requestId)` (evlog-backed).

## Model IR (frozen) [#model-ir-frozen]

Types: `ModelDefinition{fields, relations, indexes, options, hooks, scopes}`, `FieldDefinition{name, column, kind, nullable, unique, indexed, primaryKey, enumValues?}`, `RelationDefinition{type: RelationKind (belongsTo…morphToMany), target, ...}`, `ModelOptions{timestamps, softDelete, audit, tenantField?, permission?, routes, search?}`, `ModelSearchOptions{fields, language?}`, `MODEL_IR_VERSION = 1`, `toSnakeCase`, `SEARCH_LANGUAGE_PATTERN`.

## Cache (ADR-0019) [#cache-adr-0019]

`class Cache{get/set/delete/wrap/invalidateTags}`, `initCache/getCache/resetCache`, `CacheWrapOptions{ttl?, tags?, swr?}`, `CacheSetOptions{ttl?, tags?}`.

## KV [#kv]

`class Kv{get/set/delete/has/clear/namespace}`, `initKv/getKv/resetKv`, `KvSetOptions{ttl?}`.

## Store (sealed seam) [#store-sealed-seam]

`class KeyvStore`, `createKeyvDriver/createStore`, `registerStoreDriver/unregisterStoreDriver`, `serializeValue/deserializeValue`, `StoreDriverName` (`memory|file|sqlite|redis|postgres`).

## Helpers (`./helpers`) [#helpers-helpers]

`blank/filled/value/withValue/tap/transform/when/retry/throwIf/throwUnless/rescue`, `abort/abortIf/abortUnless` (CODE\_MAP: 400/401/403/404/409/422/429/500), `auth()`, `config(path?, default?)`, `env(key, default?, {source?})`, `now()`, `today()`, `provideConfig`, `dump/dd/info/logger/DumpError`, `parsePath/walkPath/getPath/setPath/hasPath/forgetPath/dataGet/dataSet/dataFill/dataForget/dataHas/head/last`, types `Path`, `PathSegment`.

## Collection (`./collection`) [#collection-collection]

`Collection<T>` class + statics (`of/fromJson/times/range`) + \~50 methods (`where/groupBy/keyBy/pluck/chunk/sliding/unique/sortBy/tap/pipe/dot/undot/collapse/pad`…), `collect(items?)`.

## Guards/HTML [#guardshtml]

`isRecord` (`./guards`), `escapeHtml(value)` (`./html`).

## Configuration sections table [#configuration-sections-table]

| Section  | Owned by | Shape                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app`    | core     | `{name?, port?, host?}`                                                                                                 |
| `logger` | core     | `{level?: "debug"\|"info"\|"warn"\|"error", sink?}`                                                                     |
| `cache`  | core     | `{driver?, prefix?, defaultTtl?, tags?, file?, url?, swrGraceMs?, waitUntil?}` (defaults: memory/kwiva/60000/tags:true) |
| `kv`     | core     | `{driver?, namespace? ("app"), defaultTtl? (300000), file?, url?}`                                                      |

> \[!TIP]
> `defineConfig` + `loadConfig` are core; other sections' validators (auth, jobs, client, events, storage, mail, mcp, search) are invoked via `applyConfigSections` (CLI).


# @kwiva/data (/api/data)



# @kwiva/data [#kwivadata]

The data package: `defineModel` (one model = schema + REST + client + audit), the fluent query builder, relations, transactions, migrations, seeders, factories.

## Model definition [#model-definition]

```ts title="src/app/models/post.ts"
import { defineModel } from "@kwiva/data";

export const Post = defineModel("posts", (f) => ({
  id: f.id(),
  title: f.string().validation((s) => s.min(1).max(200)),
  status: f.enum("draft", "published"),
  createdAt: f.dateTime(),
  author: f.belongsTo(() => User),
}), {
  timestamps: true,
  audit: true,
  routes: true,
  fillable: ["title", "status"],
  permission: "posts",
  hooks: {
    beforeCreate(record) { record.status = "draft"; },
  },
  indexes: [{ columns: ["status"] }],
});
```

**Options:** `{timestamps, softDelete, audit, tenantField?, permission?, fillable?, guarded?, hidden?, visible?, appends?, computed?, uniques?, routes, primaryKey?, search?}`.

**Fields DSL (`f`):** `id, uuid, string, text, integer, bigint, float, boolean, date, dateTime, time, enum(...values), json<T>, belongsTo, hasOne, hasMany, manyToMany, hasOneThrough, hasManyThrough, morphTo, morphMany, morphToMany`.

**Instance API:** `save/update/delete/forceDelete/restore`, `refresh`, `replicate(except?)`, `loadMissing(rel)`, `associate/dissociate`, `trashed`, `isDirty/isClean/wasChanged/getOriginal`, `toJSON`.

## Query builder [#query-builder]

```ts
const posts = await Post.where("status", "=", "published").orderBy("title").limit(10).all();
const tag = await Post.with("author").get(5);
const paginated = await Post.page(1, { size: 20 }).with("author").cursor("title", "posts");
```

| Chain                                                                                                                        | Notes                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `where/orWhere/whereIn/whereNotIn/whereNull/whereNotNull/whereBetween/whereLike/search`                                      | `search(term, {includeRank})` (model `search` option) |
| `orderBy/orderByDesc/limit/offset/select/distinct/with/withTrashed/onlyTrashed/tenant/scope/withoutGlobalScopes/whereRecord` | —                                                     |
| `has/orHas/whereHas/orWhereHas/whereDoesntHave/withCount/withAggregate`                                                      | relation-aware                                        |
| `firstOrCreate/firstOrNew/updateOrCreate/insert/pluck/chunk/lazy/cursor`                                                     | —                                                     |

## Transactions [#transactions]

`db.transaction(fn)` — nested → savepoints; `getDb()` for Kysely access.

## Migrations [#migrations]

```ts
import { defineMigration } from "@kwiva/data";
export const CreatePosts = defineMigration("20260101000000_create_posts", (db) =>
  db.createTable("posts", (t) => { t.id(); t.string("title").nullable(false); }),
);
```

## Seeders + factories [#seeders--factories]

```ts
export const SeedPosts = defineSeeder(async ({ db }) => {
  await Post.seed([{ title: "Hello" }]);
});
export const PostFactory = defineFactory(Post, (f) => ({ id: f.uuid() }));
```

## Runtime [#runtime]

`configureDatabase(config)`, `closeDatabase()`, `db`, `getKysely()`, `upsert(model, match, values)`.

## REST routes [#rest-routes]

`restRoutes(Post)` → 5 specs (list/get/create/update/remove) — wired via `@kwiva/http`.

## Search (model-integrated) [#search-model-integrated]

Model option `search: {fields: [{field, weight?}], language?}` → FTS `.search()`, `reindexSearch`, `searchCapability`. See [@kwiva/search](/api/search).

## `./testing` subpath [#testing-subpath]

`setupTestDb(models)`, `teardownTestDb()`, `truncateAll()`, `syncSchema()`, `registerFixtures({name, model}[])`.

## Database config (section `database`) [#database-config-section-database]

| Key                                                            | Type                                                     |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `driver`                                                       | `"pglite" \| "postgres"` (required)                      |
| `dataDir`                                                      | string (pglite; omit = in-memory)                        |
| `url` / `host` / `port` / `database` / `username` / `password` | Postgres connection params                               |
| `pool`                                                         | `{max?, idleTimeout?, connectionTimeout?, maxLifetime?}` |

> \[!TIP]
> `migrateGenerate` diffs models against the live DB; `probeSearch`/`reindexSearch` are used by `kwiva search:reindex`.


# @kwiva/events (/api/events)



# @kwiva/events [#kwivaevents]

Events package: `defineEvent` (sync/queued, broadcast metadata, channelFor), listeners (`defineListener` with retry/backoff options), subscribers (`defineSubscriber`), config, fakes (`fakeEvents`).

## defineEvent [#defineevent]

```ts
export const TodoCreated = defineEvent<{ id: string; title: string }>({
  broadcastOn: { module: "todos" },
  listeners: { todosChanged: defineListener({ on: TodoCreated, handle: async ({ id }) => { /* audit */ } }) },
});
```

## defineListener [#definelistener]

```ts
export const HandleTodoCreated = defineListener({
  on: TodoCreated,
  queue: { tries: 3, backoff: { maxMs: 60_000 } },
  shouldHandle(payload) { return payload.userId !== "internal"; },
  handle(payload) { /* send mail */ },
  failed(payload, error) { /* audit */ },
});
```

## Subscribers [#subscribers]

`onEvent(TodoCreated, (payload) => {...})` (sync), `defineSubscriber({name: "subscriber", events: [TodoCreated, TodoUpdated]})`.

## Broadcast → channel mapping [#broadcast--channel-mapping]

`broadcastOn: {module, ...}` → WS `channelFor(data)` — see [realtime channels](/docs/realtime/channels).

## Fake [#fake]

```ts
import { fakeEvents, assertEmitted, assertNotEmitted, restoreEvents } from "@kwiva/events";
```

> \[!TIP]
> `defineEvent` is frozen at definition; `queue.tries/backoff` duplicates of job settings — jobs vs events have separate retry systems.


# @kwiva/http (/api/http)



# @kwiva/http [#kwivahttp]

HTTP package: controller factory, contracts, middleware, server, pipeline, SSE, WebSockets, OpenAPI.

## Controller [#controller]

```ts title="src/app/http/controllers/posts.ts"
import { defineController } from "@kwiva/http";

export const PostsController = defineController({
  prefix: "/api/posts",
  permission: "posts",
  routes(api) {
    api.get("/", () => ({ items: [] }));
    api.post("/", (ctx) => ctx.input.body);
  },
});
```

### Route builder (`api`) [#route-builder-api]

| Method                                                         | Purpose                   |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `api.get(path, handler)` / `post` / `put` / `patch` / `delete` | handlers with typed `ctx` |
| `api.ws(path, options, macros?)`                               | WebSocket route           |
| `api.guard(options, setup)`                                    | scoped guard              |
| `api.group(options, setup)`                                    | scoped group              |

### `RouteDefinition` (per route) [#routedefinition-per-route]

| Field                                                                       | Type                                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`                                                                     | `{params?, query?, body?, headers?, cookie?, authorize?, prepare?}` |
| `output`                                                                    | `{schema?, status?, transform?}`                                    |
| `contract`                                                                  | `defineContract`                                                    |
| `middleware`                                                                | `Middleware[]` (refs by name)                                       |
| `bind`                                                                      | `{from, as, list?}` (resolvers)                                     |
| `handler`                                                                   | `(ctx: HttpContext) => unknown`                                     |
| `macros`, `name`, `tags`, `summary`, `description`, `deprecated`, `openAPI` | —                                                                   |

### Handlers — `HttpContext` [#handlers--httpcontext]

| Member                                                                                      | Notes                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `ctx.input`                                                                                 | destructured (`{params, query, body}`) |
| `ctx.headers()`, `ctx.setHeaders()`                                                         | headers                                |
| `ctx.json()`, `ctx.text()`, `ctx.noContent()`, `ctx.redirect(url, status?)`, `ctx.stream()` | responses                              |
| `ctx.waitUntil(promise)`                                                                    | —                                      |
| `ctx.session`, `ctx.user`, `ctx.can`                                                        | auth context                           |
| `ctx.bound(key)`                                                                            | resolver binding                       |

## Contract [#contract]

```ts title="src/app/http/contracts/post.ts"
import { defineContract } from "@kwiva/http";

export const CreatePostContract = defineContract({
  request: { body: PostBody },
  response: { schema: PostOutput, status: 201 },
});
```

## Middleware [#middleware]

| Factory                  | Purpose                                                                          |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineMiddleware(step)` | → `Middleware{step, preflight?}`                                                 |
| `cors(options?)`         | `CorsOptions{origin?, methods?, headers?, expose?, credentials?, maxAge?}`       |
| `csrf(options?)`         | `CsrfOptions{cookie?, header?, field?, exempt?, sameSite?}`                      |
| `rateLimit(options?)`    | `RateLimitOptions{max?, windowMs?, key?, message?}` — throws RATE\_LIMITED (429) |

## Server [#server]

| Symbol                                                                                          | Signature                                                             |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `createServer({port?})`                                                                         | → `AppServer{port, url, start, stop, handle(request), mount(plugin)}` |
| `bootApp(server, {controllers, middlewareGroups, models, macros, resolvers, appCtx, openAPI?})` | → `ManifestEntry[]`                                                   |
| `mountRoutes/mountWsRoutes/mountAutoRoutes/mountOpenAPI`                                        | —                                                                     |
| `findRoute(entries, name)` / `routeUrl(entries, name, params?, opts?)`                          | —                                                                     |

## WebSockets (`src/app/http/ws` or via `channel()`) [#websockets-srcapphttpws-or-via-channel]

```ts
import { channel, broadcast } from "@kwiva/http";

const Messages = channel("messages").policy((user) => !!user);
export const ChatController = defineController({
  prefix: "/ws",
  routes(api) {
    api.ws("/messages", { input: {...}, handler: async function* (ctx) { /* yield per message */ } });
  },
});
```

| API                                           | Notes                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `channel(name)` / `Channel{name, policy(fn)}` | `createChannelHandle({getSession, onCleanup}).subscribe(topic)` — policy-checked   |
| `broadcast(name, payload)`                    | in-process hub; `topicCount(topic)`                                                |
| `presence(pattern)`                           | `{onJoin, onLeave, room(key), join, leave, members(key)}` + `createPresenceHandle` |
| `AsyncQueue<T>`                               | —                                                                                  |

## SSE (`stream`) [#sse-stream]

```ts
import { stream } from "@kwiva/http";
const response = stream(async (controller) => {
  controller.enqueue("hello");
  controller.close();
});
```

## Caching [#caching]

Route-level rules (`cache`, `swr`, `isr`, `static`, `prerender`) via `ctx.response` + model cache via `@kwiva/data` + client cache via `@kwiva/client`.

> \[!TIP]
> `routeUrl` is the typed URL generator — `routeUrl(entries, "PostsController.list", { id })`.


# API Reference (/api)



# API Reference [#api-reference]

Index of Kwiva's public package surface. All entries mirror the Kwiva framework's source-of-truth inventories (`research/public-api-inventory.md`, `research/feature-inventory.md`). Stability markers: **Implemented** = public API on `main` (0.2.0+).

## Package pages [#package-pages]

| Package                                  | Stability   | Version | Role                                                                                                                                                                                          | Page                        |
| ---------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------: | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `@kwiva/core`                            | Implemented |   0.2.0 | App kernel: `defineApp`, `defineConfig`, config sections (`app`/`logger`/`cache`/`kv`), context/ALS, errors (8-code taxonomy), logger, model IR, cache, KV, store, helpers/collection barrels | [core](/api/core)           |
| `@kwiva/data`                            | Implemented |   0.2.0 | Models, query builder, relations, transactions, migrations, seeders, factories, Postgres FTS, `./testing`                                                                                     | [data](/api/data)           |
| `@kwiva/http`                            | Implemented |   0.2.0 | Controllers, contracts, middleware, pipeline, routes, REST, SSE/stream, WebSockets, OpenAPI                                                                                                   | [http](/api/http)           |
| `@kwiva/ui`                              | Implemented |   0.2.0 | Pages, layouts, SSR/streaming/islands, navigation, SEO, `./server`                                                                                                                            | [ui](/api/ui)               |
| `@kwiva/client`                          | Implemented |   0.2.0 | Typed RPC (Eden + TanStack Query), reads/mutations/upload/infinite hooks, cache persistence, WS                                                                                               | [client](/api/client)       |
| `@kwiva/auth`                            | Implemented |   0.2.0 | `defineAuth`, providers, sessions, identity, policies, gates, controllers, client hooks                                                                                                       | [auth](/api/auth)           |
| `@kwiva/jobs`                            | Implemented |   0.2.0 | Jobs, queues, workers, middleware, outbox, scheduler, failed registry, metrics                                                                                                                | [jobs](/api/jobs)           |
| `@kwiva/events`                          | Implemented |   0.2.0 | Events, listeners, broadcast, subscribers, config, fakes                                                                                                                                      | [events](/api/events)       |
| `@kwiva/mail`                            | Implemented |   0.2.0 | `defineMail`, templates, transports (memory/console/smtp/resend), config                                                                                                                      | [mail](/api/mail)           |
| `@kwiva/mcp`                             | Implemented |   0.1.0 | MCP v2 config, tool generation, `./server` handler/stdio                                                                                                                                      | [mcp](/api/mcp)             |
