# @kwiva/jobs (/api/jobs)



# @kwiva/jobs [#kwivajobs]

Queue/jobs package: `defineJob`/`defineTask`, dispatch, workers, middleware, unique keys, durable outbox, priority, observability.

## Define [#define]

| Symbol                                             | Kind     | Signature                                                                                         |
| -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineJob<TInput>(options)`                       | function | frozen `Job<TInput>` (tries ≥ 1, backoff ≥ 0, timeoutMs > 0, jitter default true)                 |
| `defineTask(options)`                              | function | `Task{kind:"task", schedule?, description?, preventOverlapping, onSuccess?, onFailure?, handler}` |
| `validateJobInput(job, raw)`                       | function | → validated input                                                                                 |
| `computeBackoffDelay(job, failedAttempt, random?)` | function | fixed/exponential, capped, jittered                                                               |

## Dispatch [#dispatch]

| Symbol                                     | Kind      | Signature                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `dispatch(job, input, opts?)`              | function  | → `Promise<string>` (record id)                              |
| `dispatchAfterResponse(job, input, opts?)` | function  | void (after-response scope)                                  |
| `dispatchSync(job, input, opts?)`          | function  | → result (1 attempt, no retries)                             |
| `dispatchChain(entries, opts?)`            | function  | sequential; `ChainResult{ok, results, failedIndex?, error?}` |
| `dispatchBatch(options)`                   | function  | → `BatchResult{ok, results, errors, skipped, handle}`        |
| `setDispatcher(fn)` / `resetDispatcher()`  | functions | fakeQueue seam                                               |

## Queue [#queue]

| Symbol                                                                                                                            | Kind      | Signature                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `createMemoryQueue(options?)`                                                                                                     | function  | `MemoryQueue{enqueue, due(now, queue?), ack, fail, has, size(queue?), pending(), failures(), clear()}` |
| `uniqueOwner(key, now?)` / `claimUnique/releaseUnique/settleUnique/clearUnique`                                                   | functions | dedupe ledger                                                                                          |
| `createJobCipher(key)` → `{encrypt, decrypt}`; `setJobCipher/getJobCipher`; `encryptJobInput/decryptJobInput/isEncryptedJobInput` | functions | AES-256-GCM                                                                                            |
| `enqueueOutbox(job, input, opts?)` / `drainOutbox(opts?)` / `getOutboxStore/setOutboxStore/resetOutboxStore`                      | functions | transactional outbox                                                                                   |
| `setDefaultEngine/getDefaultEngine/resetDefaultEngine`, `setConnectionPriorities/...`                                             | functions | engine seams                                                                                           |

## Worker + scheduler [#worker--scheduler]

| Symbol                                                                   | Kind      | Signature                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `startWorker({queues?, concurrency = 4, pollMs = 100, ...})`             | function  | → `WorkerHandle{stop, stats, stopWhenEmpty}` |
| `executeWithRetry(job, input, opts?)`                                    | function  | → `RetryResult{ok, value/error, attempts}`   |
| `defaultSleeper(ms)`                                                     | function  | —                                            |
| `parseCron(expr)`, `isDue(expr, date, tz?)`, `nextRun(expr, from?, tz?)` | functions | 5-field cron + `@yearly`..`@minutely` macros |
| `startScheduler({tasks, tickMs?, timezone?})`                            | function  | → `{tick, stop}`                             |

## Middleware [#middleware]

`throttle(key, options)` (max, windowMs, releaseMs) — over limit → `JobReleaseError{delayMs}`; `withoutOverlap(key, options?)` (`{releaseMs?, ttlMs?}`); `skipIfBatchCancelled()`; `clearThrottleBuckets/clearOverlapLocks/markBatchCancelled/isBatchCancelled/clearBatchCancelled`.

## Failed + observability [#failed--observability]

| Symbol                                                                      | Kind      | Signature                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `failedJobs()`                                                              | function  | append-only registry (`FailedJob{id, queue, attempts, input, error, errorCode?, failedAt}`) |
| `recordFailed/removeFailed/pruneFailed/clearFailed`                         | functions | —                                                                                           |
| `retryFailed(id, opts?)`, `retryAllFailed(opts?)`, `describeFailure(error)` | functions | —                                                                                           |
| `queueMetrics(engine?)`                                                     | function  | `QueueMetrics{pending, pendingByQueue, failed, processed, succeeded, inFlight, workers}`    |
| `onJobEvent(event, handler)` / `offJobEvent` / `clearJobEvents`             | functions | `JobEvent ∈ "processing"\|"retrying"\|"processed"\|"failed"`                                |

## Batch [#batch]

`createBatchRecord(total)`, `getBatchRecord(id)`, `batchProgress(id)`, `cancelBatch(id)`, `isBatchRecordCancelled(id)`, `clearBatchRecord(id)`, `clearBatchRecords()`, `BatchProgress{total, pending, completed, failed, skipped, cancelled}`.

## Testing [#testing]

| Symbol        | Kind     | Signature                                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fakeQueue()` | function | → `QueueFake{dispatched, assertDispatched, assertNotDispatched, assertNothingDispatched, assertDispatchedCount, restore}` |

## Usage [#usage]

```ts title="src/app/jobs/send-welcome.ts"
import { defineJob } from "@kwiva/jobs";
import { dispatch } from "@kwiva/jobs";
import { sendWelcomeMail } from "@kwiva/mail";

export const SendWelcomeJob = defineJob({
  handler(input) {
    sendWelcomeMail(input.userId);
  },
  onSuccess() {
    // audit
  },
});

await dispatch(SendWelcomeJob, { userId: 123 }, { delayMs: 5000 });
```

> \[!TIP]
> `kwiva dev` picks up jobs automatically; workers run via `startWorker({queues: ["default"]})`.


# @kwiva/mail (/api/mail)



# @kwiva/mail [#kwivamail]

Mail package: declarative mailing with `defineMail`, markdown/string/component templates, and transports (memory, console, SMTP, Resend).

## Mailable [#mailable]

| Symbol                                                                                                     | Kind     | Signature                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defineMail(options)`                                                                                      | function | `Mailable{to(recipient): PendingMail, send, queue, later}` |
| `PendingMail<T>.send(data, transport?)` / `.queue(data, transport?)` / `.later(delayMs, data, transport?)` | methods  | `Promise<OutgoingMessage>`                                 |

Field semantics — `MailField<TData, V> = V \| ((data: TData) => V)`:

| Field                                | Type                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `to`                                 | `Address \| Address[]` — `formatAddress(addr)`, `Address = string \| {address, name?}` |
| `cc`, `bcc`                          | `Address \| Address[]`                                                                 |
| `replyTo`                            | `Address \| Address[]`                                                                 |
| `from`                               | `Address`                                                                              |
| `subject`                            | string or `(data) => string`                                                           |
| `render(data): string`               | → template string                                                                      |
| `html?`                              | `string` (raw HTML)                                                                    |
| `markdown?`                          | `string` (raw markdown)                                                                |
| `text?`                              | `string` (plain)                                                                       |
| `tags?`, `metadata?`, `attachments?` | arrays/objects                                                                         |

## Transports [#transports]

| Symbol                                                    | Kind      | Signature                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `setTransport(t)` / `getTransport()` / `resetTransport()` | functions | —                                                               |
| `class MemoryTransport`                                   | class     | `{name: "memory", sent: OutgoingMessage[], send(msg), clear()}` |
| `class ConsoleTransport`                                  | class     | `{name: "console", send(msg)}`                                  |
| `Transport{name, send(message): void\|Promise<void>}`     | interface | —                                                               |
| `defineMailTransport(definition)`                         | function  | → `MailTransportDefinition{name, create()}`                     |

## Transports in repo [#transports-in-repo]

* `@kwiva/mail-smtp` — `SmtpTransport` (Nodemailer-backed, `name: "smtp"`; options `host`, `port` = 587, `secure`, `auth: { user, pass }`, `from`, `pool`, `maxConnections`, `ignoreTLS`, `requireTLS`).
* `@kwiva/mail-resend` — `ResendTransport` (`name: "resend"`; options apiKey, from?, baseUrl?; data attachments only — throws on `path`).

## Config [#config]

| Symbol                                                         | Kind      | Signature                                         |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `setMailConfig(cfg)` / `getMailConfig()` / `resetMailConfig()` | functions | `MailConfig{transport?, from?}`                   |
| `validateMailConfig(section)`                                  | function  | asserts shape (non-empty `from`, known transport) |

## Templates [#templates]

| Symbol                                                                      | Kind      | Signature                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `renderString(template, data)`                                              | function  | `{{ key }}` dotted interpolation; missing → `""` |
| `markdownToHtml(src)`                                                       | function  | —                                                |
| `renderMarkdown(template, data)`                                            | function  | —                                                |
| `mailButton({text, url})`, `mailPanel(content)`, `mailTable(headers, rows)` | functions | —                                                |

## Usage [#usage]

```ts title="src/app/mail/todo-mail.ts"
import { defineMail } from "@kwiva/mail";
import { smtpTransport } from "@kwiva/mail-smtp";

export const TodoMail = defineMail({
  to(user) {
    return user.email;
  },
  from: "todos@example.com",
  subject: () => "Your todo was created",
  render() {
    return `Todo created`;
  },
});

await TodoMail(user).send({ todoId: 42 }, smtpTransport);
```

> \[!TIP]
> Set the transport globally with `setMailTransport(new MemoryTransport())` in tests; use `formatAddress` for headers.


# @kwiva/mcp (/api/mcp)



# @kwiva/mcp [#kwivamcp]

MCP package (v2, built on `@modelcontextprotocol/server`): config, tool generation from models/controllers, custom tools, HTTP fetch handler + stdio server.

## Config (`src/config/mcp.ts`) [#config-srcconfigmcpts]

`McpConfig{enabled?: boolean, route?: string (default "/mcp"), transport?: "streamable"|"stdio" (default "streamable"), auth?: "session"|"bearer"|"none" (default "session"; none only with stdio), models?: string[], controllers?: string[], readOnly?: boolean, scopes?: string[], requireTenant?: boolean}` — `validateMcpConfig` throws `KwivaError("BAD_REQUEST")`.

> \[!TIP]
> With `auth: "bearer"` the handler enforces `X-API-Key`-less bearer tokens (see [auth](/api/auth) — `apiTokenAuth`); `bearer` keys come from `@kwiva/auth` API tokens.

## Tool generation [#tool-generation]

| Symbol                                                          | Notes                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `generateModelTools({config, models?, executor?})`              | tools named `{table}_{action}`; actions `list/get/create/update/delete`; `readOnly` → only list/get; `requireTenant` filtering |
| `generateControllerTools({config, manifest?, executor?})`       | tools named `{controller}_{action}` from route manifest                                                                        |
| `defineMcpTool({description?, input, ability, handler, name?})` | custom tools — `ability: "resource.action"` (e.g. `"posts.read"`)                                                              |
| `registerMcpTool(name, tool)`, `MCP_TOOL_SUFFIX = "Tool"`       | —                                                                                                                              |
| `inputToJsonSchema(input)`, `validateToolInput(input, raw)`     | Standard Schema → JSON Schema; validation errors → 400 with fields                                                             |

## Server (`./server`) [#server-server]

| Symbol                                                                                            | Notes                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `createMcpServerHandler({config, tools, resolveScope?, logger?, rateLimiter?, rateLimitWindow?})` | `McpHandler{fetch(request): Promise<Response>}` — POST-only, 405 on GET/HEAD; session auth via cookies, bearer auth via header, audit logging |
| `runStdio({config, tools, ...})`                                                                  | → `McpStdioHandle{close()}`; requires `auth: "none"`                                                                                          |
| `executeToolCall({tool, name, input, scope, options})`                                            | rate limit → validate → ability → tenant → handler                                                                                            |
| `toolError(code, message?, fields?)`, `toolErrorFromException(error)`                             | —                                                                                                                                             |

Rate limiting: `DEFAULT_RATE_WINDOW{max: 120, windowMs: 60000}`; returns `TOOL_ERROR` 429.

## What tools can do [#what-tools-can-do]

Tools are policy-checked: `ability` string (`resource.action`) → `can(policy, user, action, resource)` from the app registry; `tenantId` from `currentTenant()`; results shaped `McpToolResult{content: McpTextContent[], isError?, structuredContent?}`.

> \[!TIP]
> Generated tools respect `readOnly: true` — `create/update/delete` tools are excluded.


# @kwiva/search (/api/search)



# @kwiva/search [#kwivasearch]

Search package: declarative Postgres full-text search over model IR + federated multi-model search.

## Config [#config]

| Symbol                                                | Kind     | Signature                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `validateSearchConfig(input)`                         | function | → `SearchConfig{engine: "postgres", language?}` |
| Types: `SearchConfig`, `SearchConfigSection{search?}` | types    | —                                               |

## Model integration [#model-integration]

Search-ready models set `search: {fields: [{field, weight?}], language?}` in `defineModel` options. FTS column: `search_vector`. Weight enum: `SearchWeight = "A" \| "B" \| "C" \| "D"` (Postgres config weight semantics).

## Federated search [#federated-search]

| Symbol                               | Kind     | Signature                                                     |
| ------------------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `searchAcross(models, term, limit?)` | function | → `SearchHit[]{model, row, rank}` sorted by `searchRank` desc |
| Type: `SearchHit{model, row, rank}`  | type     | —                                                             |

## Reindex [#reindex]

| Symbol                                                                         | Kind      | Signature                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `probeSearch(db, table)` / `reindexSearch(db, table)` / `searchCapability(db)` | functions | per-table ops (verified in CLI, `kwiva search:reindex`) |

> \[!TIP]
> `kwiva search:reindex [model]` prints `reindexed N searchable model(s)` or per-model result; requires `database` section.

| ------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |

| `clearAssetManifestCache()`                 | function | —                                         |

## Usage [#usage]

```ts title="src/app/http/controllers/files.ts"
import { storage } from "@kwiva/storage";

const res = await storage.put("avatar.png", file.arrayBuffer(), { contentType: "image/png" });
```

> \[!TIP]
> Tenancy-scoped config makes `storage.disk("local").put("a.txt", ...)` prefix-scoped per tenant via `currentTenant()`.


# @kwiva/testing (/api/testing)



# @kwiva/testing [#kwivatesting]

In-process test harness.

## Main barrel [#main-barrel]

| Symbol                                                                                                                                                                                         | Kind     | Signature                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `withApp(fn, options?)`                                                                                                                                                                        | function | → `WithAppContext{server, handler, client, registry, config, manifest}`; options `{cwd?, name?, db?, routes?, baseUrl?, extraControllers?, clientScript?, extraScripts?, services?, state?}` |
| `createTestClient(server, options?)`                                                                                                                                                           | function | → `TypedClient`                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Re-exports: `defineFactory` (@kwiva/data), `setupTestDb/teardownTestDb/truncateAll` (@kwiva/data/testing), `fakeQueue` (@kwiva/jobs), `fakeEvents/assertEmitted/restoreEvents` (@kwiva/events) | —        | —                                                                                                                                                                                            |

WithApp semantics: boots the real app in-process (nested calls throw), teardown resets auth/client/query/policies/WS-hub.

## `./boot` subpath — `bootAppFromRoot(options?)` → `BootedRoot{server, registry, config, manifest, models, appUnits}` [#boot-subpath--bootappfromrootoptions--bootedrootserver-registry-config-manifest-models-appunits]

## Test DB helpers (@kwiva/data/testing, re-exported here) [#test-db-helpers-kwivadatatesting-re-exported-here]

`setupTestDb(models)` — fresh in-memory PGLite + `registerModel` + `syncSchema()`; `teardownTestDb()`; `truncateAll()`; `syncSchema()`; `registerFixtures({name, model}[])`.

> \[!TIP]
> With `withApp`, `ctx.client` is the in-process typed client; `ctx.handler(request)` for raw Request handling; `ctx.server` for `handle()`.


# @kwiva/ui (/api/ui)



# @kwiva/ui [#kwivaui]

The frontend package: pages, layouts, routing, SSR, islands, navigation, and SEO. (Formerly separate `@kwiva/react` and `@kwiva/router` package pages — merged into this page.)

## Exports map [#exports-map]

| Subpath    | Target                                   | Symbols                                    |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `.`        | `src/index.ts`                           | all below                                  |
| `./server` | `src/server.ts` → `src/render/server.ts` | `createPagesController`, `discoverLayouts` |

## Pages — `definePage` [#pages--definepage]

| Symbol                                   | Kind      | Signature                                                     |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `definePage(options \| path, options)`   | function  | `Page{kind:"page", path?, load?, render, head?, middleware?}` |
| `Page` type                              | type      | `{kind, path?, load, render, head, middleware[]}`             |
| `redirect(path, status?)` / `notFound()` | functions | throw `PageRedirect`/`PageNotFound`                           |
| `resolveHead(page, props)`               | function  | → `PageHead`                                                  |
| `pagesFromRegistry(units)`               | function  | → `DiscoveredPage[]`                                          |
| `PageNotFound`, `PageRedirect`           | classes   | —                                                             |

| Symbol                                 | Kind     | Signature                                                        |

| Symbol                                       | Kind      | Signature                                                                              |

| Asset helpers                                | functions | `assetUrl(manifest, name)`, `assetTags(manifest, entry?)`, `parseAssetManifest(value)` |

## SEO [#seo]

| Symbol                                               | Kind      | Signature                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |

## Usage [#usage]

```ts title="src/ui/pages/posts.$id.tsx"
import { definePage } from "@kwiva/ui";
import { notFound } from "@kwiva/ui";

export default definePage({
  load(ctx) {
    return { id: ctx.params.id };
  },
  render({ props }) {
    return <main>{props.id}</main>;
  },
});
```

> \[!TIP]
> Pages are auto-discovered from `src/ui/pages` (recursive, `$param`/`*` routes). Layouts from `src/ui/layouts`.


# Welcome to Kwiva (/blog/welcome-to-kwiva)



Kwiva is here. The batteries-included TypeScript application framework: one defineX grammar for every construct, a framework-owned `@kwiva/*` API surface, a single config folder, one CLI, and zero runtime codegen.

Try it:

```bash title="terminal"
bun install
kwiva create my-app
cd my-app
kwiva dev
```

## Highlights [#highlights]

| Package                                   | Role                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@kwiva/core`                             | App kernel, config, context/ALS, errors, logger, model IR, cache, KV, store |
| `@kwiva/data`                             | Models, query, migrations, seeders, factories, FTS search                   |
| `@kwiva/http`                             | Controllers, contracts, middleware, routing, SSE, WebSockets, OpenAPI       |
| `@kwiva/ui`                               | Pages, layouts, SSR, islands, navigation, SEO                               |
| `@kwiva/client`                           | Typed RPC, hooks, cache, WS                                                 |
| `@kwiva/auth` + `@kwiva/auth-better-auth` | Auth, policies, gates, identity                                             |
| `@kwiva/jobs`                             | Queues, workers, middleware, outbox, scheduler                              |
| `@kwiva/events`                           | Events, broadcast metadata, subscribers                                     |
| `@kwiva/mail`                             | Mail, templates, transports                                                 |
| `@kwiva/mcp`                              | MCP v2 — model/controller tools, server                                     |

> \[!TIP]
> See [what's new since 0.2.0](/docs/research/public-api-inventory) — full inventory.

**Docs:** [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started) — now covering 19 packages + the new features (MCP v2, storage, search, cache, testing).


# Why one defineX grammar (/blog/why-definex)



Every app-facing construct in Kwiva is a `defineX` factory. `defineModel`, `defineController`, `definePage`, `defineJob`, `defineEvent`, `defineTask`, `definePolicy`, `defineModule` — the list keeps growing, but the shape never changes. Some people assume this is a branding tic. It isn't. The one-grammar rule is the mechanism that keeps a full-stack framework coherent.

## The problem with different grammars [#the-problem-with-different-grammars]

Consider the alternative: models as classes, controllers as route objects, pages as component exports, jobs as bare functions. Each construct gets its own "natural" syntax. That works fine in a library. In a framework that spans data, HTTP, frontend, and platform concerns, it compounds into real costs:

* **Two mental models.** Every file type you touch asks you to re-learn a convention.
* **Two tooling surfaces.** Generators, lint rules, and IDE support must be written per-shape.
* **Two error surfaces.** "Why does my class look different from my function?" is a real question developers ask.
* **Two testing habits.** Patterns don't transfer between constructs.

None of these are fatal on their own. Together, they turn onboarding into a small tax you pay forever.

## One grammar, everywhere [#one-grammar-everywhere]

The `defineX` convention collapses that tax:

```ts title="src/app/models/posts.ts"
// src/app/models/posts.ts
export default defineModel('posts', (f) => ({ ... }), { timestamps: true })

// src/app/http/controllers/posts.ts
export default defineController('posts', (c) => ({ ... }), { prefix: '/posts' })

// src/app/jobs/send-welcome.ts
export default defineJob('send-welcome', async ({ payload }) => { ... }, { queue: 'mail' })
```

Same shape, different domain. Once you understand `defineModel`, you already know how `defineJob` works — the arguments differ, the contract doesn't.

## It enables the tooling [#it-enables-the-tooling]

Because every construct shares a grammar, the framework can build tooling that covers all of them at once:

* **Generators.** `kwiva make:*` scaffolds every construct from one template engine.
* **Lint gates.** One rule can enforce conventions across models, controllers, pages, and jobs.
* **Auto-discovery.** Files are found by directory, so nothing needs manual registration.
* **Type inference.** Types flow through the whole stack from a single source — no codegen step, no duplicate type definitions.

## It makes reading the app possible [#it-makes-reading-the-app-possible]

Here's the quiet payoff. When every file follows the same shape, reading a codebase becomes reading a product description:

> "The app has a `posts` model with title, body, and status. It has a controller exposing five actions. It has a `send-welcome` job on the mail queue. When a user signs up, the `user.signed-up` event dispatches it."

That's not a summary written after the fact — it's the code, rendered flat. One grammar is the difference between a codebase you navigate and a codebase you read.

## The boundary it draws [#the-boundary-it-draws]

There's a second, subtler reason. The `defineX` convention draws a hard line between what's framework and what's application. App code imports only `@kwiva/*` and writes only `defineX(...)`. Everything underneath — the internal engines, the toolchain — is framework-owned. One grammar makes that boundary legible: if it's not a `defineX`, it isn't app code.

## The tradeoff [#the-tradeoff]

Uniformity has a cost: some constructs *could* be more concise in a bespoke syntax. A single-action controller is more ceremonious than a bare function. But the framework's position is deliberate — consistency compounds, cleverness doesn't. The small ceremony of a factory call buys coherence across every concern, every package, and every developer who joins later.

That's why the grammar is one of the four design pillars. It's not decoration — it's the architecture.
